items.ma-4465: Muʿtamir narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the gourd and the pitch-coated [vessel], that nabīdh be made in them.
items.ma-4471: Muʿtamir narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Prophet of Allah ﷺ forbade that the livestock of the people be milked except with their permission.
items.ma-4533: al-Walīd ibn Muslim narrated to us, from al-Awzāʿī, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: I prayed with the Prophet ﷺ at Minā two rakʿahs.
items.ma-4591: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAmr, from al-Zuhrī, from Ibn ʿUmar, Sālim being between them: that the Prophet ﷺ used to pray two rakʿahs after the Jumuʿah.
items.ma-4592: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAmr, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from his father: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when the dawn shone, would pray two rakʿahs.
items.ma-4616: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ informed me, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Prophet ﷺ said: “Good is in the forelocks of the horses until the Day of Resurrection.”
items.ma-4630: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade the price of the ʿasb of the stallion.
items.ma-4655: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ informed me, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not prevent the female servants of Allah from the mosques of Allah.”
items.ma-4664: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Two must not converse privately to the exclusion of the third.”
items.ma-4678: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ informed me, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The vision is one part of seventy parts of prophethood.”
items.ma-4930: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it: that ʿUmar asked the Prophet ﷺ.
items.ma-4943: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ibn Dīnār, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that fruit be sold until its soundness appears.
items.ma-5048: Ḥusayn narrated it to us, Shaybān narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Saʿd, the mawlā of the family of ʿUmar, and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-5108: And he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Aslam – Allah has made them safe; and Ghifār – Allah has forgiven them; and ʿUṣayyah disobeyed Allah and His Messenger.”
items.ma-5169: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ informed me, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When one of you comes to the Jumuʿah, let him perform ghusl.”
items.ma-5311: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Mālik, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “When one of you comes to the Jumuʿah, let him perform ghusl.”
items.ma-5330: Isḥāq ibn ʿĪsā narrated to us, Mālik informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to come to Qubāʾ riding and walking.
items.ma-5656: Qurād narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Prophet ﷺ made the horses race, and gave the one who came first.
items.ma-5686: Muḥammad ibn Bishr narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Prophet ﷺ had two muʾadhdhins.
items.ma-5777: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever comes to the Jumuʿah, let him perform ghusl.”
items.ma-5843: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-ʿUmarī narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to raise his hands level with his shoulders.
items.ma-5870: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Muṣʿab narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade najsh.
items.ma-5904: Muʾammal also narrated it to us, from Sufyān, like the ḥadīth of Ayyūb, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, also.
items.ma-6164: al-Ḥakam ibn Nāfiʿ narrated to us, Ismāʿīl ibn ʿAyyāsh narrated to us, from Ṣāliḥ ibn Kaysān, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, like that.
items.ma-6229: Isḥāq narrated it to us, Mālik informed me, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Five of the beasts,” and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-6232: I read to ʿAbd al-Raḥmān: Mālik, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ made [his camel] kneel at al-Baṭḥāʾ which is at Dhū al-Ḥulayfah, and prayed there.
items.ma-6291: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: On the day of Khaybar the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the meat of domestic donkeys.
items.ma-6294: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade qazaʿ.
items.ma-6694: Yazīd narrated to us, from Ḥajjāj, from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, from his father, from his grandfather: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ combined the two prayers on a journey.
items.ma-7294: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, raising it: “When one of you yawns, he places his hand over his mouth.”
items.ma-7312: Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “A resident must not sell for a desert-dweller.”
items.ma-7526: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid narrated to us, ʿAwf narrated to us, from Ibn Sīrīn, from Abū Hurayrah, like it.
items.ma-7559: “And fruit is not to be sold until its soundness appears.”
items.ma-7783: ʿAttāb narrated it to us, ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Yūnus narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, he said: Ibn Abī Unays narrated to us, and he mentioned it.
items.ma-7850: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-8119: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “In the Jumuʿah there is an hour which no Muslim coincides with while asking his Rabb for something, except that He gives it to him.”
items.ma-8157: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Straighten the row in the prayer, for straightening the row is part of the excellence of the prayer.”
items.ma-8161: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The vision of the righteous man is one part of forty-six parts of prophethood.”
items.ma-8170: And he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Were it not for Banū Isrāʾīl, meat would not have turned foul, and were it not for Ḥawwāʾ, no female would ever have betrayed her husband.”
items.ma-8175: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed, among wrongdoing is the procrastination of the wealthy, and when one of you is referred to a solvent person, let him follow.”
items.ma-8214: And he said: “Ghaḍab Allāh has intensified upon a man whom the Messenger of Allah kills in the cause of Allah.”
items.ma-8231: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When one of you stands at night, and the Qurʾān becomes obscure upon his tongue so that he does not know what he is saying, let him lie down.”
items.ma-8241: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The Hour will not come until you fight a people whose sandals are hair.”
items.ma-8469: Yaʿqūb narrated it to us, my father narrated to us, from his father, he said: Abū Salamah ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to me: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ – and he mentioned it as mursal.
items.ma-8710: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Renew your īmān.” It was said: O Messenger of Allah, and how do we renew our īmān? He said: “Increase in saying: There is no deity except Allah.”
items.ma-9146: Ibrāhīm ibn Abī al-ʿAbbās narrated to us, he said: Abū Uways narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Faḍl and Abū al-Zinād narrated to us, from al-Aʿraj, like it.
items.ma-9296: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, he said: Maʿmar said: And someone other than Hammām added for me, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The most lying of people are the craftsmen.”
items.ma-9387: And he said: “Seek refuge with Allah from five: from the punishment of Jahannam, and the punishment of the grave, and the fitnah of life and of death, and the fitnah of al-Masīḥ al-Dajjāl.”
items.ma-9414: And he said: “Ghifār – Allah has forgiven them; and Aslam – Allah has made them safe.”
items.ma-9415: And he said: “By the One in whose Yad is the soul of Muḥammad, if you knew what I know, you would weep much and laugh little.”
items.ma-9547: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ibn Abī ʿArūbah, from Qatādah, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Jābir, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-9586: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Hishām, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “A woman is not to be married over her paternal aunt, nor over her maternal aunt.”
items.ma-9755: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Suhayl, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “He has more right to his seat if he returns to it.”
items.ma-10124: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Hishām, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-10248: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Ḥammād, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “Woe to the heels from the Fire.”
items.ma-10539: Yazīd narrated to us, Muḥammad informed us, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Disputation about the Qurʾān is kufr.”
items.ma-10613: Yazīd narrated to us, Hishām informed us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, similar to it.
items.ma-10682: Rawḥ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, Ibn Abī Ḥusayn al-Makkī narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn ʿĀṣim, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-10746: Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd narrated to us: Ibn Shihāb used to strike in the wind.
items.ma-10897: And he said: “The shuhadāʾ are five: the one struck by plague, the one afflicted in his belly, the drowned, the one beneath a collapse, and the shahīd in the cause of Allah.”
items.ma-11026: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, that the Prophet ﷺ forbade the ikhtināth of waterskins.
items.ma-11071: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed on a mat.
items.ma-11443: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sharīk, from Suhayl, from his father, from Abū Saʿīd, he said: When the Prophet ﷺ followed a funeral procession, he would not sit until it was put down.
items.ma-11522: And by this chain: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever has seen me has seen me [as] the truth, for Shayṭān does not take shape through me.”
items.ma-11630: Muʾammal also narrated it to us, and he said: from Abū Naḍrah, from Jābir.
items.ma-11763: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ addressed us on the Day of Naḥr; and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-11872: Rawḥ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Abū al-Mutawakkil, from Abū Saʿīd, that a man came to the Prophet ﷺ, and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-11963: Muʿtamir narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ loved that the Muhājirūn and the Anṣār be next to him in the prayer.
items.ma-11966: Muʿtamir narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: Abū Ṭaybah cupped the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he gave him a ṣāʿ of food, and spoke to his people, and they lightened [it] for him.
items.ma-11967: Muʿtamir narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was among the most complete of people in prayer and the briefest.
items.ma-12029: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us: Bundār narrated to us, he said: Ibn Abī ʿAdī narrated to us part of this ḥadīth, he said: So I came to him and upon him was a cloak.
items.ma-12161: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, Hishām ibn Zayd narrated to me, he said: I heard Anas ibn Mālik say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that animals be confined.
items.ma-12250: Muʿtamir ibn Sulaymān narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, that Anas ibn Mālik was granted a lifespan of a hundred years less one year.
items.ma-12378: Bahz narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that unripe dates and dried dates be steeped together.
items.ma-12386: Abū al-Naḍr narrated to us, Sulaymān narrated to us, meaning.
items.ma-12421: Ḥammād ibn Masʿadah narrated to us, from Qurrah ibn Khālid, from Qatādah, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ mentioned Uḥud and said: “A mountain that loves us and we love it.”
items.ma-12445: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ – his hair did not pass his ears.
items.ma-12500: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Zayd narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Abī Bakr ibn Anas narrated to us, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, similar to it.
items.ma-12550: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Leave what makes you doubt for what does not make you doubt.”
items.ma-12577: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim, similar to it.
items.ma-12601: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas, he said: The hair of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not pass his ears.
items.ma-12702: Muʿtamir narrated to us, from his father, he said: I heard Anas say: The Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever lies about me deliberately, let him take his seat in the Fire.”
items.ma-12728: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, ʿUmārah – meaning Ibn Zādhān – narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas: that the gourd pleased the Prophet ﷺ.
items.ma-12793: Muʾammal narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Zayd narrated to us, Thābit narrated to us, from Anas, like it.
items.ma-12852: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Mālik ibn Anas narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Prophet ﷺ entered Makkah in the year of the Conquest wearing a helmet.
items.ma-12881: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: The prayer was established while the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was in private conversation with a man, until some of the people dozed – or were about to doze.
items.ma-12903: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah said: I heard Thābit, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ raised his hands until the whiteness of his armpits was seen.
items.ma-12990: Bahz narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, he said: Qatādah informed us, he said: Anas ibn Mālik narrated to me: that the Prophet ﷺ performed qunūt for a month, then abandoned it.
items.ma-13064: Yazīd narrated to us, Ḥumayd informed us, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ loved that the Muhājirūn and the Anṣār be next to him in the prayer, so that they would take from him.
items.ma-13444: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Prophet ﷺ prayed behind Abū Bakr in one garment, while he was sitting.
items.ma-13544: Isḥāq narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim al-Aḥwal, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: “O you with the two ears.”
items.ma-13551: Surayj narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Eat the suḥūr, for in the suḥūr there is blessing.”
items.ma-13612: ʿAffān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “For every treacherous one there is a banner on the Day of Resurrection.”
items.ma-13641: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ performed qunūt for a month, then abandoned it.
items.ma-13721: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, he said: I saw with Anas ibn Mālik a cup that had belonged to the Prophet ﷺ, with a ḍabbah of silver on it.
items.ma-13722: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated it to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim, and he mentioned it.
items.ma-13856: ʿAffān narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Wārith narrated to us, Abū al-Tayyāḥ narrated to us, Anas ibn Mālik narrated to us, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was the best of people in character.
items.ma-13891: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, like it, except that he doubted regarding ʿUthmān.
items.ma-13919: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, he heard Anas say: The moon was split in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-13940: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas, he said: The Prophet ﷺ said: “The son of the sister of a people is of them.”
items.ma-13960: Rawḥ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, he said: I heard Manṣūr, he said: I heard Ṭalq ibn Ḥabīb narrate from Anas ibn Mālik, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-14005: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Saʿīd narrated to us, from Ḥanẓalah, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed qunūt for a month after the bowing.
items.ma-14038: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, from al-Jaʿd Abū ʿUthmān, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: “O my little son.”
items.ma-14177: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, Abū al-Zubayr informed me, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “War is deception.”
items.ma-14350: Ḥasan narrated to us, Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of fruit until it becomes good.
items.ma-14565: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, my father narrated to me, Ayyūb narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the plastering of graves.
items.ma-14623: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Jābir: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was the most extreme of people in lightening the prayer.
items.ma-14639: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of surplus water.
items.ma-14668: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ rebuked that one urinate in stagnant water.
items.ma-14758: Mūsā narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, that he said: The Prophet ﷺ commanded us concerning the day of ʿĀshūrāʾ, that we fast it.
items.ma-14832: Sulaymān ibn Ḥayyān narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: I do not know with how many the Prophet ﷺ threw.
items.ma-14851: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Malik narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the gourd and the pitch-coated [vessel].
items.ma-14858: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb narrated to us, Hishām informed us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of date palms until they yield food.
items.ma-15055: Yazīd narrated to us, from Ḥajjāj, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray on the day of the ʿĪd, then deliver a khuṭbah.
items.ma-15093: He said: And I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Indeed, the thing I fear most for my ummah is the deed of the people of Lūṭ.”
items.ma-15208: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr informed me, that he heard Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh say: And I do not know with how many he threw the jamrah.
items.ma-15295: ʿAlī ibn Baḥr narrated to us, ʿĪsā narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, like it, except that he said: “zakāh and mercy.”
items.ma-15413: Qurrān narrated to us in the ḥadīth, he said: He would throw the jamarāt from a camel of his.
items.ma-15583: Wahb ibn Jarīr narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Abū Iyās, from his father: that he came to the Prophet ﷺ, and he supplicated for him and wiped his head.
items.ma-15640: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, Layth narrated to us, he said: Zabbān ibn Fāʾid narrated to me, from Ibn Muʿādh ibn Anas, from his father, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, like that.
items.ma-15671: ʿAffān narrated to us, Mūsā ibn Khalaf Abū Khalaf narrated to us – and he was counted among the budalāʾ –, and he mentioned another ḥadīth similar to it.
items.ma-15928: Sufyān narrated to us, Abū al-Zinād narrated to us, he said: The family of Jarhad informed me, from Jarhad, he said: “The thigh is ʿawrah.”
items.ma-16121: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from Ibn al-Zubayr, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “A single suck and two sucks do not prohibit.”
items.ma-16168: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sharīk, from Yaʿlā ibn ʿAṭāʾ, from Aws ibn Abī Aws, from his father: that the Prophet ﷺ performed wuḍūʾ, and wiped over his sandals.
items.ma-16495: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: ʿIkrimah ibn ʿAmmār narrated to us, from Iyās ibn Salamah, from his father, he said: The Prophet ﷺ had a boy called Rabāḥ.
items.ma-16508: Ḥammād ibn Masʿadah narrated to us, from Yazīd – meaning Ibn Abī ʿUbayd – from Salamah: that he asked permission of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ regarding the desert, and he gave him permission.
items.ma-16641: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid, from a man of Thaqīf, from his father, “that the Prophet ﷺ urinated and sprinkled his private part.
items.ma-16681: And I asked him about the children of the polytheists, and he said: “Kill them with them.” He said: And he had forbidden concerning them on the day of Khaybar.
items.ma-16841: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Mujammiʿ ibn Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Abū Umāmah ibn Sahl, from Muʿāwiyah: that the Prophet ﷺ used to make the tashahhud with the muʾadhdhins.
items.ma-16904: Yaʿqūb narrated it to us, he said in it: “And beware of praising one another, for it is slaughter.”
items.ma-16950: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from al-Ḥasan, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-17547: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abān narrated to us, Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr narrated to us, from Abū Ibrāhīm, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, similar to it.
items.ma-17806: Isḥāq ibn ʿĪsā narrated to us, he said: Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to me, from Abū Qabīl, from ʿAmr ibn al-ʿĀṣ, he said: I comprehended from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ a thousand parables.
items.ma-18669: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from his father, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Barāʾ, he said: The Prophet ﷺ went on fifteen expeditions.
items.ma-18712: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Abū Janāb narrated to us, from Yazīd ibn al-Barāʾ, from his father, that the Prophet ﷺ delivered a khuṭbah upon a bow, or a staff.
items.ma-18839: Yazīd narrated to us, Ḥajjāj informed us, from ʿAbd al-Jabbār ibn Wāʾil, from his father, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he prostrated, place his nose on the ground.
items.ma-19048-r2: ʿAbd Allāh said: And Shaybān narrated to us, Abū Hilāl narrated to us, he said: and he mentioned something similar to it.
items.ma-19105: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Misʿar narrated to us, ʿUbayd ibn Ḥasan narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Awfā, that the Prophet ﷺ used to say that, and he did not say: in the prayer.
items.ma-19172: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Ẓabyān, from Jarīr, like that.
items.ma-19208: He said: And the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever is deprived of gentleness is deprived of good.”
items.ma-19210: Abū Usāmah narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl, from Qays, from Jarīr, he said: I have not been veiled from him since I became Muslim, and he did not see me except that he smiled in my face.
items.ma-19250: Yaḥyā narrated to us, he said: Ismāʿīl said: Qays said: Jarīr said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not veil me since I became Muslim, and he never saw me except that he smiled.
items.ma-19255: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar informed us, from Abū Isḥāq, from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Jarīr, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-19257: Aswad narrated it to us, Yūnus narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Jarīr, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, and he mentioned it.
items.ma-20035: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Bahz, and he mentioned like it, and he said: “So Allah is more deserving that one be shy before Him,” and he placed his hand on his private part.
items.ma-20129: And from Samurah, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The middle prayer is the ʿAṣr prayer.”
items.ma-20152: Bahz narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The ʿumrā is permitted for its people.”
items.ma-20173: al-Ashyab narrated to us, Shaybān narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿUmayr, from Ḥuṣayn ibn Abī al-Ḥurr al-ʿAnbarī, and he mentioned like the ḥadīth of Zuhayr.
items.ma-20187: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Aḥmad ibn Jamīl narrated to us, Ibn al-Mubārak narrated to us, like it.
items.ma-20232: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, from Firās, from al-Shaʿbī, from Samurah, and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-20237: ʿAbdah narrated to us, Saʿīd narrated to us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of an animal for an animal on credit.
items.ma-20255: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The middle prayer is the ʿAṣr prayer.”
items.ma-20442: Yaʿqūb narrated to us, my father narrated to us, from his father, from his grandfather, from Abū Bakrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, and he mentioned like it.
items.ma-20471: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, I heard Hishām narrate, from al-Ḥasan, from Abū Bakrah, like it.
items.ma-20482: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from ʿAlī ibn Zayd, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Bakrah, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-20501: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Thābit and Yūnus, from al-Ḥasan, from Abū Bakrah, and he mentioned it.
items.ma-20508: And Abū Bakrah said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Who is in charge of the affair of Persia?” They said: A woman. He said: “A people whose affair a woman is in charge of will not succeed.”
items.ma-20511: He said: And Abū Bakrah said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The two months of ʿĪd do not fall short: Ramaḍān and Dhū al-Ḥijjah.”
items.ma-20652: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ narrated to me, he said: Sometimes Ibn ʿUmar led us [in prayer] with two sūrahs and three [sūrahs].
items.ma-20701: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah, from the Prophet ﷺ, exactly like it.
items.ma-20812: Abū Qaṭan narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Simāk, from Jābir ibn Samurah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was ashkal of the eye, thin of the heel.
items.ma-20887: He said: And I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Indeed, Allah named al-Madīnah Ṭābah.”
items.ma-21017: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Simāk, from Jābir ibn Samurah, he said: Bilāl used to call the adhān when the sun declined.
items.ma-21031: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Simāk, from Jābir ibn Samurah, he said: I saw it like the egg of a dove, its colour the colour of his body.
items.ma-21034: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Simāk, from Jābir ibn Samurah: that the Prophet ﷺ used to remind in his khuṭbah.
items.ma-21391: ʿAbdah narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, and he mentioned it, except that he said: Which mosque was first set down on the earth?
items.ma-21398: And Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, Zāʾidah narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, Sulaymān ibn Mushir narrated to us, from Kharashah, and he mentioned it.
items.ma-21496: Marwān narrated to us, Qudāmah al-Bakrī narrated to us, and he mentioned something similar, and he said: “shrink back from worship.”
items.ma-21934: Abū Kāmil narrated to us with its meaning, he said: “Indeed, it is not for me – or he said: it is not for a prophet – to enter a decorated house.”
items.ma-22049: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, Thābit narrated to us, he said: Abū Ẓabyah came to us and narrated to us, and he mentioned the like of this ḥadīth.
items.ma-22222: Rawḥ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, of the people of Ḥimṣ, of Banū al-ʿAddāʾ of Kindah, he said: I heard Abū Umāmah, like it.
items.ma-22388: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Sālim, from Thawbān, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Be upright toward Quraysh as long as they are upright toward you.”
items.ma-22448: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb narrated to us, Hishām ibn Abī ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Sālim, from Maʿdān, from Thawbān, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-22531: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Naṣr ibn ʿAlī narrated it to us, Sufyān narrated to us, and he said: from the Prophet ﷺ.
items.ma-22917: Zakariyyā ibn ʿAdī narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh – meaning Ibn ʿAmr – informed us, and he mentioned the ḥadīth, except that he said: al-Ashjaʿī.
items.ma-23247: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Ibrāhīm, from Hammām, from Ḥudhayfah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “No talebearer will enter Paradise.”
items.ma-24077: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Mālik, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Qāsim, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed the Ḥajj as ifrād.
items.ma-24121: Sufyān narrated to us, from Hishām, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered Makkah from the upper part of Makkah, and left from its lower part.
items.ma-24137: Sufyān narrated to us, ʿAmr narrated to us, from ʿAṭāʾ, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not die until women were made lawful for him.
items.ma-24139: Ḥafṣ ibn Ghiyāth narrated to us, he said: al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū al-Ḍuḥā, from Masrūq, from ʿĀʾishah: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray while I was in front of him.
items.ma-24277: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ibn Abī Mulaykah, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The most hated of men is the most vehement in contention, the quarrelsome.”
items.ma-24293: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The bedding of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was of tanned leather, its stuffing of palm fibre.
items.ma-24511: Hāshim narrated to us, al-Layth narrated to us, he said: Nāfiʿ narrated to me, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar, like that.
items.ma-25239: Ḥammād ibn Masʿadah narrated to us, Ashʿath narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from Saʿd ibn Hishām, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade tabattul.
items.ma-25352: Maʿmar said: And Hishām ibn ʿUrwah informed me, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, like this, and he added: He said: “When you see that, give ṣadaqah and pray.”
items.ma-25369: Hushaym narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Malik, from ʿAṭāʾ, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to perform ghusl from one vessel.
items.ma-25375: Hushaym narrated to us, from Mughīrah, from Ibrāhīm, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I used to wear an izār while I was menstruating, and I would enter with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ under his blanket.
items.ma-25781: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Prophet ﷺ used to pray at night thirteen rakʿahs.
items.ma-25868: Ḥusayn narrated to us, he said: Ibn Abī Dhiʾb narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, and he mentioned it with its chain and its meaning.
items.ma-25873: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, from Hishām, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, like it.
items.ma-25930: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, Quṭbah narrated to us, and he mentioned the two of them together, and he said: the two legs of the bed.
items.ma-25978: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid narrated to us, he said: Hishām narrated to us, from Shumaysah, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade the nabīdh of the jarr.
items.ma-26055: Abū Dāwūd narrated to us, Shuʿbah informed us, from ʿĀṣim the mawlā of Qurayyibah, from Qurayyibah, from ʿĀʾishah, and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-26228: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Abū ʿImrān al-Jawnī, from Yūsuf ibn Saʿd, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-26229: Yūnus narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Abū ʿImrān al-Jawnī, from Yūsuf ibn Saʿd, from Abū Salamah, from ʿĀʾishah, like it.
items.ma-26930: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Hishām, he said: Fāṭimah narrated to me, from Asmāʾ, she said: We ate the meat of a horse of ours in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-27088: Bishr ibn al-Mufaḍḍal narrated to us, from Saʿd ibn Isḥāq, he said: Zaynab bint Kaʿb narrated to me, from Furayʿah bint Mālik, from the Prophet ﷺ, similar to it.
items.ma-27524: And ʿAffān said: Bukayr ibn Abī al-Sumayṭ narrated to us, by this chain, exactly like it.
items.ma-27627: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, he said: Abū Mūsā al-Harawī narrated to us, he said: ʿĪsā ibn Yūnus narrated to us by his chain, and he mentioned like it.
items.ma-4539: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from his father: that he saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, Abū Bakr and ʿUmar walking in front of the funeral procession.
items.ma-4558: It was read to Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah: al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Let him not eat from the meat of his sacrificial animal beyond three [days].”
items.ma-4582: It was read to Sufyān: I heard Ayyūb, from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of ḥabal al-ḥabalah.
items.ma-4610: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ informed me, he said: Ibn ʿUmar would sometimes lead us in prayer reciting two surahs and three in the obligatory prayer.
items.ma-4649: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ informed me, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever carries weapons against us is not of us.”
items.ma-4681: Yaḥyā narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh informed me, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ planted the spear [in the ground] and prayed toward it.
items.ma-4682: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ informed me, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ changed the name of ʿĀṣiyah, [and] said: “You are Jamīlah.”
items.ma-4699: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Mālik, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it, similar to it.
items.ma-4738: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: He ﷺ forbade that goods be met [on the road] until they enter the markets.
items.ma-4777: And Abū Aḥmad, meaning al-Zubayrī, narrated it to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAlqamah ibn Marthad, from Sulaymān ibn Razīn.
items.ma-4817: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj narrated to us, from Sulaymān ibn Mūsā, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The walāʾ belongs to the one who freed.”
items.ma-4846: Yazīd narrated to us, Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd informed us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to come to Qubāʾ riding and walking.
items.ma-4888: Maʿmar said: And Ayyūb informed me, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, like it.
items.ma-4890: He said: And Maʿmar narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-4911: Ibn Abī Shaybah narrated it to us, from Muʿtamir, from Muḥammad ibn ʿUthaym, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, meaning with this ḥadīth.
items.ma-4953: Yaḥyā ibn Zakariyyā narrated to us, Mālik ibn Anas narrated to me, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ attached the son of the woman who had performed liʿān to his mother.
items.ma-5116: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Layth informed us, from Mujāhid, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ prayed two rakʿahs in the House.
items.ma-5263: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from al-ʿUmarī, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever does not answer the invitation has disobeyed Allah and His Messenger.”
items.ma-5356: ʿAlī ibn Ḥafṣ narrated to us, Warqāʾ informed us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade qazaʿ in the head.
items.ma-5363: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah and ʿAbd al-Wārith narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-5415: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Thābit, he said: I asked Ibn ʿUmar about the vessels. He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade those vessels.
items.ma-5550: ʿAlī ibn Ḥafṣ narrated to us, Warqāʾ narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade qazaʿ in the head.
items.ma-5623: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar informed us, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ shaved his head during his Ḥajj.
items.ma-5665: Hāshim narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿIṣam, I heard Ibn ʿUmar say: The Prophet ﷺ said: “Indeed, among Thaqīf there is a great liar and a destroyer.”
items.ma-5838: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from al-ʿUmarī, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: When the journey became urgent for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he would combine the Maghrib and the ʿIshāʾ [prayers].
items.ma-5841: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ prayed toward a camel.
items.ma-6223: Nūḥ ibn Maymūn narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ, Abū Bakr, ʿUmar and ʿUthmān alighted at al-Muḥaṣṣab.
items.ma-6451: Ḥammād ibn Khālid narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Do not meet the riders,” and he forbade najsh.
items.ma-6456: Ḥammād narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Let the beards grow, and trim the moustaches.”
items.ma-6500: Abū Nuʿaym narrated to us, from Sufyān, from al-Aʿmash, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Ziyād, like it, or similar to it.
items.ma-6728: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, my father narrated to us, Dāwūd narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, from his father, from his grandfather, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said … like it.
items.ma-6927: Abū Muʿāwiyah, meaning al-Ḍarīr, narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Ziyād, and he mentioned something similar to it.
items.ma-7194: He said: “And whoever Allah wants good for, He gives understanding in the religion. I am only a distributor, and Allah ﷿ gives.”
items.ma-7374: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: he prostrated them both after the salām.
items.ma-7393: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl ibn Umayyah, from Abū ʿAmr ibn Ḥurayth, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, attributing it [to the Prophet], and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-7854: And he, meaning ʿAbdah, said: ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Saʿīd ibn Abī Saʿīd, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-7866: ʿAffān narrated to us, Wuhayb narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, he doubted in it: “a witness or an intercessor.”
items.ma-8105: Aswad, meaning Shādhān, said in this ḥadīth: When he entered the latrine, I would bring him water in a tawr or in a rakwah, and he mentioned it with its isnād.
items.ma-8124: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “By the One in Whose Yad is the soul of Muḥammad, if you knew what I know, you would laugh little and weep much.”
items.ma-8125: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When one of you fights, let him avoid the face.”
items.ma-8133: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever loves the meeting with Allah, Aḥabba Allāh liqāʾah; and whoever does not love the meeting with Allah, lam Yuḥibba Allāh liqāʾah.”
items.ma-8136: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The Hour will not be established until two great factions fight one another, between whom there will be a great slaughter, while their claim is one.”
items.ma-8155: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “By Allah, I do not give you anything, nor do I withhold it from you; I am only a treasurer; I place [it] where I am commanded.”
items.ma-8162: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Let the young greet the old, the one passing the one sitting, and the few the many.”
items.ma-8167: And with its isnād he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The space of the whip of one of you in Paradise is better than what is between the heaven and the earth.”
items.ma-8190: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Let none of you call the grape ‘al-karm’; al-karm is only the Muslim man.”
items.ma-8209: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If two people are compelled to take an oath and both prefer it, let them draw lots over it.”
items.ma-8235: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If you say to the people, ‘Be silent,’ while they are speaking, you have spoken idly against yourself.”
items.ma-8242: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Arrogance and boasting are among the people of horses and camels, and tranquility is among the people of sheep.”
items.ma-8967: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, he said: ʿAwf narrated to us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like that.
items.ma-8979: ʿAffān narrated to us, he said: Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, he said: Abū ʿUmar al-Ghudānī narrated. ʿAffān said: with this ḥadīth.
items.ma-9131: Hawdhah narrated to us, ʿAwf narrated to us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Name yourselves with my name, and do not take my kunyah.”
items.ma-9386: He said: “And Qayṣar will perish, and there will be no Qayṣar after him; and Kisrā will perish, and there will be no Kisrā after him.”
items.ma-9399: And he said: “Among the people of my ummah who love me most intensely are people who will come after me; one of them would wish that he had seen me [at the cost of] his family and his wealth.”
items.ma-9412: And he said: “You will find among the best of people those who most dislike this matter, until he falls into it.”
items.ma-9417: And he said: “In Paradise there is a tree in whose shade a rider travels for a hundred years without crossing it.”
items.ma-9425: And he said: “The one who sits in the mosque has three outcomes: a brother gained, or a firm word, or a mercy awaited.”
items.ma-9478-3: And Zāʾidah also narrated it to us; Muʿāwiyah, meaning, from him.
items.ma-9642: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “The believer feels jealousy, and Allāh is Ashaddu ghayran.”
items.ma-9650: And he ﷺ said: “Indeed, in Paradise there is a tree in whose shade a rider travels for a hundred years without crossing it.” So recite, if you wish: {And extended shade} [al-Wāqiʿah: 30].
items.ma-9781: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from ʿUmārah ibn al-Qaʿqāʿ, from Abū Zurʿah, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Prophet ﷺ had a silent pause in the prayer.
items.ma-9864: Aswad narrated it to us, he said: Sharīk narrated to us, and he mentioned something like it.
items.ma-9877: Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, he said: Zāʾidah narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim, with his isnād, he said: “Among the affairs of the Rabb ﷿.”
items.ma-9969: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever uses stones [for cleaning], let him do so an odd number of times.”
items.ma-9988: He said: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that one urinate in standing water that does not flow, and then wash from it. Muʾammal said: in stagnant [water], and then wash from it.
items.ma-10039: He said: And he used to seek refuge from five: from the punishment of the grave, the punishment of Jahannam, the fitnah of life, the fitnah of death, and the fitnah of the Masīḥ al-Dajjāl.
items.ma-10181: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-Awzāʿī narrated to us, from Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-10266-2: And: “Whoever sells a muṣarrāh [animal], the buyer has the option for three days; if he wishes he may return it and return with it a ṣāʿ of dates.”
items.ma-10351: And Yazīd ibn Hārūn narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah informed us, from Qatādah, from Abū ʿUmar al-Ghudānī, from Abū Hurayrah, and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-10454: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, from Yūnus, and he did not attribute it [to the Prophet].
items.ma-10672: Rawḥ narrated to us, ʿAwf narrated to us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-10686: Rawḥ narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-11124: ʿUthmān ibn Muḥammad narrated to us – and I heard it myself from ʿUthmān – Jarīr narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from ʿAṭiyyah, from Abū Saʿīd, and he mentioned something similar to it.
items.ma-11235: And he said: “Al-shiyāʿ is ḥarām.” Ibn Lahīʿah said: meaning by it the one who boasts of sexual intercourse.
items.ma-11239: And from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, that he said: “What is between the two leaves of a door in Paradise is like the distance of a journey of forty years.”
items.ma-11935: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from a man, from Abū Saʿīd, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-11978: Ismāʿīl ibn Ibrāhīm narrated to us, ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn Ṣuhayb narrated to us, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Prophet of Allah ﷺ forbade a man to perfume himself with saffron.
items.ma-12039: Ibn Abī ʿAdī narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Thābit, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw a man being supported between his two sons, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-12043: Ibn Abī ʿAdī narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The Hour will not be established until it is no longer said on the earth: ‘Allah, Allah.’”
items.ma-12101: It was read to Sufyān: I heard Ibn Judʿān, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The voice of Abū Ṭalḥah in the army is better than a company.”
items.ma-12128: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: The prayer was called [to begin] while the Messenger of Allah was in private conversation with a man, until some of the people dozed off – or were about to doze off.
items.ma-12174: Abū Aḥmad narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim, from Yūsuf ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Ḥārith, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-12183: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas, he said: I saw the Prophet ﷺ slaughtering his sacrificial animal with his hand.
items.ma-12191: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Jarīr ibn Ḥāzim, from Qatādah, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ had cupping done on the two akhdaʿayn and on the kāhil.
items.ma-12213: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, he said in this ḥadīth: Thirty [nights and days] came upon me, between a day and a night.
items.ma-12231: Yazīd narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he said: “Indeed, part of the excellence of the prayer is the straightening of the row.”
items.ma-12389: Abū Kāmil narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Thābit al-Bunānī, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Prophet ﷺ's hair would not go beyond his ears.
items.ma-12411: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, he said: Sharīk narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, he said: I saw with Anas ibn Mālik a cup that had belonged to the Prophet ﷺ, with a silver band on it.
items.ma-12833: Yaḥyā narrated to us, Ḥumayd narrated to us, from Anas, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say: “O Allah, I seek refuge with You from laziness, miserliness, and the punishment of the grave.”
items.ma-12846: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to me, from al-Suddī, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Prophet ﷺ used to turn away [after the prayer] to his right.
items.ma-12868: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ said to a man: “Become Muslim.” He said: I find myself disliking [it]. He said: “Even if you dislike [it].”
items.ma-12870: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, he said: I heard Anas say: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Labbayka, for ʿumrah and Ḥajj.”
items.ma-12891: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Hishām informed us, like it, and he said: “Its expiation is burying it.”
items.ma-12905: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Hammām, from Qatādah, he said: I said to Anas: Which garment was most beloved to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ? He said: The ḥibarah.
items.ma-12925: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Maʿmar, from Qatādah, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went round to his wives with one ghusl.
items.ma-13082: Yazīd narrated to us, Ḥumayd informed us, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The Hour will not be established until it is no longer said on the earth: ‘Allah, Allah.’”
items.ma-13231: ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade a man to drink standing.
items.ma-13280: ʿUmar ibn Saʿd narrated to us, from Sufyān, from ʿĀṣim, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed qunūt for a month.
items.ma-13432: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Wāqid narrated to us, from al-Thawrī, from Jābir, from Abū Naṣr, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave me a kunyah after a plant that I used to pick.
items.ma-13448: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas, he said: The Prophet of Allah ﷺ was among the lightest of people in prayer while [making it] complete.
items.ma-13500: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ saw phlegm on the qiblah wall of the mosque and scraped it off with his hand.
items.ma-13587: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, Layth narrated to us, ʿUqayl narrated to me, and he mentioned it.
items.ma-13627: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade that dates and unripe dates be steeped together.
items.ma-13810: ʿAlī ibn Isḥāq narrated it to us, ʿAbd Allāh informed us, al-Muthannā informed us, from Qatādah, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-13837: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, Anas ibn Mālik narrated to us that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If you knew,” and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-13857: ʿAffān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “For every treacherous person there will be a banner on the Day of Resurrection by which he is known.”
items.ma-14016: And with this isnād and wording: that the Prophet of Allah ﷺ used to say: “Do not turn your backs on one another, do not hate one another, do not envy one another, and be, O servants of Allah, brothers.”
items.ma-14054: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, like it, except that he said: “Straighten yourselves and press closely together.”
items.ma-14201: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Ḥammād ibn Salamah, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that a drawn sword be passed [from hand to hand].
items.ma-14223: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Sufyān informed us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, like it.
items.ma-14243: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Hishām, from Yaḥyā, from Abū Salamah, from Jābir, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The ʿumrā belongs to the one to whom it was given.”
items.ma-14261: Hushaym narrated to us, from Abū Bishr, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “How excellent a relish is vinegar.”
items.ma-14380: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ pronounced the talbiyah in his Ḥajj for the Ḥajj.
items.ma-14422: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Malik, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Jābir, he said: We used to perform tamattuʿ with the Prophet ﷺ, and we would slaughter a cow on behalf of seven, sharing in it.
items.ma-14613: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Jābir: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that one clean oneself [after relieving oneself] with dung or with a bone.
items.ma-14644: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of surplus water.
items.ma-14655: Yaḥyā ibn Isḥāq narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Prophet ﷺ was the lightest of people in prayer while [making it] complete.
items.ma-14767: Mūsā narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the price of the sinnawr, which is the cat.
items.ma-15001: Abū Saʿīd narrated to us, Layth narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ bought one slave for two slaves.
items.ma-15057: Yazīd narrated to us, Sulaymān informed us, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, the keeper of the siqāyah, from Jābir, like it; and Jābir explained: a shortening of the life-span.
items.ma-15080: Sufyān narrated to us, Ibn ʿAqīl narrated to us, from Jābir: that the Prophet ﷺ ate bread and meat, then prayed and did not perform wuḍūʾ.
items.ma-15142: Mūsā ibn Dāwūd narrated it to us, Zuhayr narrated to us, like it, with its isnād.
items.ma-15268: Aḥmad ibn ʿAbd al-Malik narrated to us, Zuhayr narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Wāʾil, from Abū Masʿūd, from the Prophet ﷺ, similar to it.
items.ma-15593: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, from Muʿāwiyah ibn Qurrah, from his father, he said: The Prophet ﷺ wiped over my head.
items.ma-15683: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from ʿĀmir ibn Rabīʿah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-15878: He said: And I heard him say to the people: “Whoever affirms the oneness of Allah and disbelieves in what is worshipped besides Him, his property and his blood become inviolable, and his reckoning is with Allah ﷿.”
items.ma-15983: ʿAlī ibn Baḥr narrated to us, he said: Ḥātim narrated to us, Muḥammad ibn Sulaymān al-Kirmānī narrated to us; and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-16245: Sulaymān ibn Dāwūd narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Muʿāwiyah ibn Qurrah, from his father: that he came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he had milked and tied [the udders].
items.ma-16550: Makkī narrated to us, Yazīd ibn Abī ʿUbayd narrated to us, from Salamah, he said: We used to pray the Maghrib with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when it [the sun] had disappeared behind the veil.
items.ma-16678: Abū al-Qāsim ibn Abī al-Zinād narrated to us, from al-Zanjī, he said: I saw al-Zuhrī dyeing his head with black.
items.ma-16683: And I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “There is no ḥimā except for Allah and His Messenger.”
items.ma-16688: [ʿAbd Allāh ibn Aḥmad said:] Isḥāq narrated to us, he said: Rawḥ ibn ʿUbādah informed us, like it, meaning: from Mālik. And Rawḥ said: his face.
items.ma-16735: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Muḥammad ibn Jubayr ibn Muṭʿim, from his father, that he heard the Prophet ﷺ recite al-Ṭūr in the Maghrib prayer.
items.ma-16793: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Hishām, he said: I heard al-Ḥasan, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Mughaffal, that the Prophet ﷺ forbade combing the hair except occasionally.
items.ma-16942: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Suhayl ibn Abī Ṣāliḥ, and he mentioned the like of it, except that he said: “The religion is only sincere advice,” three times.
items.ma-17105: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Salamah ibn Kuhayl, similar to it.
items.ma-17176: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, and he mentioned it, and he said: from al-Miqdām of Kindah, and he was one of the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ, from the Prophet ﷺ, similar to it.
items.ma-17399: And he said: “Three [are those] whose supplication is answered: the traveller, the parent, and the wronged.”
items.ma-17671: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Saʿīd narrated to us, and he mentioned the ḥadīth. And he said: Maṭar said: “And neither ṣarf nor ʿadl will be accepted from him.”
items.ma-17718: Yazīd ibn Hārūn narrated to us, he said: Ismāʿīl informed us, from Qays, he said: ʿAdī ibn ʿAmīrah narrated to me, and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-17727: Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān said: And Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn narrated to me, he said: Muʿtamir ibn Sulaymān narrated to us, and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-17903: And I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Three days of the month is a good fast.”
items.ma-18143: [ʿAbd Allāh ibn Aḥmad said:] Saʿīd ibn Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd al-Umawī narrated to us, he said: My father narrated to me, al-Mujālid narrated to us, from ʿĀmir, like it.
items.ma-18241: Bahz ibn Asad narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, Ḥabīb ibn Abī Thābit narrated to us. And he mentioned the like of it, he said: “Then he is one of the two liars.”
items.ma-18721: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Salamah ibn Nubayṭ narrated to us, from his father – and he had performed Ḥajj with the Prophet ﷺ – he said: I saw him delivering a sermon on the Day of ʿArafah on his camel.
items.ma-18807:
He said: And I heard Jundab say: The finger of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ bled, so he said:
“Are you anything but a finger that bled, and in the cause of Allah, what you have met?”
items.ma-19015: [ʿAbd Allāh ibn Aḥmad said:] Aḥmad ibn Ḥātim al-Ṭawīl narrated it to us, ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz al-Darāwardī narrated to us, like it.
items.ma-19130: Isḥāq ibn Yūsuf narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Ibn Abī Awfā, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “The Khawārij are the dogs of the Fire.”
items.ma-19646: Yaḥyā narrated to us, Thābit, meaning Ibn ʿUmārah, narrated to us, Ghunaym ibn Qays narrated to us, from Abū Mūsā, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Every eye is an adulterer.”
items.ma-19816: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Saʿīd narrated to us, from Qatādah, he said: I heard Zurārah ibn Awfā narrate from ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-19818: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Khālid ibn Rabāḥ al-Hudhalī narrated to us, from Abū al-Sawwār al-ʿAdawī, from ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-20143: ʿAbdah narrated to us, from Saʿīd, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of an animal for an animal on credit.
items.ma-20155: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Saʿīd, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The middle prayer is the ʿAṣr prayer.”
items.ma-20239: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb narrated to us, from Saʿīd, like it, except that he said: “Whoever encloses.”
items.ma-20250: And Surayj ibn al-Nuʿmān narrated it to us, Hushaym narrated to us, from Yūnus, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-20318: Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān said: Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn and Huraym Abū Ḥamzah narrated to us, both said: Muʿtamir narrated to us, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-20710: Bahz narrated to us, from Hammām, the ḥadīth of the shaqīṣ in the slave, mursal.
items.ma-20717: Abū Saʿīd narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it, and he did not mention “from Hudhayl.”
items.ma-20858: And that a man killed himself, and the Prophet ﷺ did not pray over him.
items.ma-20864: Abū Kāmil narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from Simāk, from Jābir ibn Samurah: that a man killed himself, and the Prophet ﷺ did not pray over him.
items.ma-21036: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Isrāʾīl, from Simāk, from Jābir ibn Samurah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed, before the Hour there will be liars.”
items.ma-21187: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim, from Zirr, from Ubayy, from the Prophet ﷺ, similar to it.
items.ma-21440: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, Fiṭr narrated to us, from al-Mundhir, from Abū Dharr, in meaning.
items.ma-21474: Abū al-Naḍr narrated to us, Mahdī narrated to us, and he did not mention Abū al-Aswad.
items.ma-21526: Hudbah narrated to us, Sulaymān ibn al-Mughīrah narrated to us, and he mentioned the like of it with its isnād.
items.ma-21538: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Qudāmah ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from Jasrah, that she heard Abū Dharr: that the Prophet ﷺ stood [in prayer] one night with a verse, repeating it.
items.ma-21605: ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, Ibn Abī Dhiʾb informed us, like it, except that he said: “May Allah fight the Jews.”
items.ma-21711: Abū Saʿīd also narrated to us, Zāʾidah narrated to us, al-Sāʾib ibn Ḥubaysh al-Kalāʿī narrated to us, and he mentioned it.
items.ma-21826: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Ashʿath, from al-Ḥasan, from Usāmah ibn Zayd, from the Prophet ﷺ that he said: “The cupper and the one who has cupping done have broken their fast.”
items.ma-21834: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Ibn Dharr, from Mujāhid, from Usāmah ibn Zayd, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ moved on [from ʿArafah] in tranquility, and he commanded them to observe tranquility.
items.ma-22620: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abān narrated to us, from Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr, from Abū Ibrāhīm, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, with something similar to it.
items.ma-22628: Abū Saʿīd narrated to us, Ḥarb, meaning Ibn Shaddād, narrated to us, Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr narrated to us, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-22691: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, and he mentioned it; he said: from the son of ʿUbādah's wife, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-22834: Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū Ḥāzim, from Sahl ibn Saʿd, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “I and the Hour were sent like this from this.”
items.ma-22847: Bishr ibn al-Mufaḍḍal narrated to us, Abū Ḥāzim narrated to us, from Sahl ibn Saʿd, he said: We used to take the midday rest and eat the midday meal after the Friday [prayer] with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-22915:
Aswad narrated it to us, from Sharīk, he said: al-Ashʿarī.
And he said: “If he does that, he will be encircled with seven earths.”
items.ma-23226: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid, from a man of Thaqīf, from his father: that the Prophet ﷺ urinated and sprinkled his private part.
items.ma-23284: Muḥammad ibn Bakr narrated to us, Kathīr ibn Abī Kathīr narrated to us, Ribʿī ibn Ḥirāsh narrated to us, from Ḥudhayfah: that he came to him at al-Madāʾin, and he mentioned it.
items.ma-23296: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Ghālib, from Ḥudhayfah, he said: The master of the children of Ādam on the Day of Resurrection is Muḥammad ﷺ.
items.ma-23351: ʿAffān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from al-Walīd ibn al-ʿAyzār, from Abū ʿAmr al-Shaybānī, from Ḥudhayfah, with all of this.
items.ma-23541: And with it: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he performed wuḍūʾ, would rinse his mouth and wipe his beard from beneath with water.
items.ma-24094: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The child belongs to the bed.”
items.ma-24213: Ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Sulaymān, he said: I heard Khaythamah, and he said: He would hasten the breaking of the fast and delay the suḥūr.
items.ma-24438: Mūsā narrated to us, Ibn Abī al-Zinād narrated to us, from Hishām ibn ʿUrwah, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, like it.
items.ma-24729: Abū Salamah narrated to us, from Mālik, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Qāsim, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed Ḥajj ifrād.
items.ma-25151: And he said: from ʿĀʾishah: He liked the comprehensive supplications, and would leave what is between that.
items.ma-25247: Ḥasan ibn al-Rabīʿ narrated it to us, Dāwūd ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Manṣūr ibn Ṣafiyyah, from his mother, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-25461: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Zāʾidah narrated to us, he said: Ismāʿīl al-Suddī narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh al-Bahī, he said: ʿĀʾishah narrated to me, and he mentioned it.
items.ma-25588:
Wakīʿ narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, with something similar to it.
Wakīʿ said: “And perform ghusl, and pronounce the talbiyah for Ḥajj.” ʿUrwah said: So Allah ﷿ fulfilled her Ḥajj and her ʿumrah.
items.ma-25719: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Abū al-Zubayr, from ʿĀʾishah and Ibn ʿAbbās, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ visited the House at night.
items.ma-25768: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Hishām, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: A baby boy was brought to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he urinated on him, so he followed it with water and did not wash it.
items.ma-25785: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Hārūn, from Budayl, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Shaqīq, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Prophet ﷺ recited: {then [there is] rest and fragrance} [al-Wāqiʿah: 89].
items.ma-26217: Hāshim narrated to us, Shaybān narrated to us, from Layth, from ʿAṭāʾ, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The cupper and the one cupped have broken their fast.”
items.ma-26225: Hudbah narrated to us, he said: Abān al-ʿAṭṭār narrated to us, he said: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Abū Salamah, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-26351: Ibrāhīm ibn Khālid narrated to us, he said: Rabāḥ narrated to us, he said: I said to Maʿmar: Was the Messenger of Allah ﷺ taken [in death] while he was sitting? He said: Yes.
items.ma-26567: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abān narrated to us, with something similar to it in this isnād, except that he said: from one vessel, after sexual impurity.
items.ma-26859: Sufyān said: Salamah said: ʿUbayd ibn Abī al-Jaʿd narrated to me, from Muslim, something like this ḥadīth.
items.ma-27303: Ibn Abī ʿAdī narrated to us, from Ibn ʿAwn, from Muḥammad, from Umm ʿAṭiyyah, she said: We were forbidden to follow funeral processions, but it was not made binding upon us.
items.ma-27616: [ʿAbd Allāh said:] Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar al-Warakānī narrated to us, Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Isḥāq, and he mentioned the like of it, similar to it.
items.ma-4324: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb narrated to us, from Saʿīd, from Qatādah, from Abū al-Aḥwaṣ, from Ibn Masʿūd, that the Prophet ﷺ said … like it.
items.ma-4443: He said: And Hushaym narrated to us, he said: Ibn Abī Laylā informed us, from al-Qāsim ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from Ibn Masʿūd, and in it there is not: from his father.
items.ma-4466: Muʿtamir narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When one of you comes to the Jumuʿah, let him perform ghusl.”
items.ma-4491: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Ayyūb narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade the sale of ḥabal al-ḥabalah.
items.ma-4526: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade shighār.
items.ma-4530: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Mālik, from Abū Bakr ibn ʿUmar, from Saʿīd ibn Yasār, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed witr on the camel.
items.ma-4604: ʿAbdah narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-4663: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ dealt with the people of Khaybar for half of what came out of it, of dates or crops.
items.ma-4708: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ informed me, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade al-talaqqī.
items.ma-4750: Muḥammad ibn Fuḍayl narrated to us, from Yazīd, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Laylā, from Ibn ʿUmar, that he kissed the hand of the Prophet ﷺ.
items.ma-4950: Ḥammād ibn Usāmah narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, Nāfiʿ narrated to us, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, this hadith and this description.
items.ma-4955: Yaḥyā ibn Zakariyyā narrated to us, Ḥajjāj narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stayed in Madinah for ten years, offering the sacrifice.
items.ma-5034: Abū al-Naḍr narrated it to us, with its meaning.
items.ma-5094: Abū Kāmil narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “When one of you swears,” and he mentioned it.
items.ma-5110: Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from ʿĀʾishah and Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ visited by night.
items.ma-5156: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ informed me, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the gourd and the pitch-coated [vessel].
items.ma-5157: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ informed me, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ cut [the hand] for a shield whose price was three dirhams.
items.ma-5305: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Mālik, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ, when the journey hurried him, would combine the Maghrib and the ʿIshāʾ [prayers].
items.ma-5309: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Mālik, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever buys food, let him not sell it until he has received it in full.”
items.ma-5527: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, Ibn Shihāb informed me of that, from Sālim, regarding the hady and the sacrifices.
items.ma-5655: Qurād narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Prophet ﷺ protected al-Naqīʿ for his horses.
items.ma-5657: Qurād narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ used to sit between the two khuṭbahs.
items.ma-5660: Abū al-Naḍr narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Bahiyy, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Prophet ﷺ used to pray on the khumrah.
items.ma-5840: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-ʿUmarī narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that a spear would be planted for the Prophet ﷺ on the two ʿĪds, and he would pray toward it.
items.ma-5952: Aswad narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Abū Bakr ibn Ḥafṣ, from Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ sent a ḥullah to ʿUmar, and he mentioned it.
items.ma-5962: Ḥusayn narrated to us, from Jarīr, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about the desert lizard, and he said: “I do not eat it and I do not prohibit it.”
items.ma-6047: Abū Nūḥ narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ performed ramal from the Black Stone to the Black Stone.
items.ma-6080: Yūnus narrated to us, Fulayḥ narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Prophet ﷺ only turned aside to the mountain pass for his need.
items.ma-6104: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah and ʿAbd al-Wārith narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-6115: Shujāʿ ibn al-Walīd narrated to us, from Mūsā ibn ʿUqbah, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ shaved his head in the Farewell Ḥajj.
items.ma-6230: And I read to ʿAbd al-Raḥmān: Mālik, from Nāfiʿ, also.
items.ma-6267: Muʿtamir narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Whoever comes to the Jumuʿah, let him perform ghusl.”
items.ma-6422: ʿAlī ibn Ḥafṣ narrated to us, Warqāʾ informed us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade qazaʿ on the head.
items.ma-6779: ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the one who gives a bribe and the one who takes it.
items.ma-7014: Muʾammal narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Shahr, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The one who is killed defending his property is a shahīd.”
items.ma-7299: Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, by way of narration, he said: “Allah ﷿ said: My Raḥmah has preceded My Ghaḍab.”
items.ma-7425: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Sulaymān, from Dhakwān, from Abū Hurayrah, and he did not raise it, similar to it.
items.ma-7453: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Delay by the wealthy is injustice, and if one of you is referred to a solvent person, let him follow.”
items.ma-7768: Yazīd narrated to us, Ibn Abī Dhiʾb informed us, from al-Zuhrī, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh al-Agharr, similar to it.
items.ma-7809: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, just like the hadith of al-Zuhrī.
items.ma-8004: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Abū Ziyād, the mawlā of al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī, he said: I heard Abū Hurayrah … and he mentioned it.
items.ma-8143: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed Allah ﷿ said: I have prepared for My righteous servants what no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and what has not occurred to the heart of any human.”
items.ma-8146: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Allah has ninety-nine names, one hundred except one; whoever counts them enters Paradise. Indeed He is Witr, Yuḥibbu al-witr.”
items.ma-8150: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “I was given victory through dread, and I was given the comprehensive words.”
items.ma-8174: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Richness is not from an abundance of goods, but richness is the richness of the soul.”
items.ma-8184: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When the owner of livestock does not give its due, it will be spread out against him on the Day of Resurrection, trampling his face with its hooves.”
items.ma-8207: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “You will not cease to ask for rulings until one of you says: This is Allah, He created the creation; so who created Allah ﷿?”
items.ma-8208: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “By Allah, for one of you to persist in his oath regarding his family is more sinful for him with Allah than that he give its kaffārah which Allah ﷿ has made obligatory.”
items.ma-8211: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The old man is upon the love of two things: length of life and abundance of wealth.”
items.ma-8213: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The Ghaḍab of Allah ﷿ became intense upon a people who did to the Messenger of Allah” – and at that moment he was pointing to his front tooth.
items.ma-8221: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Cool down from the heat in the prayer, for the intensity of the heat is from the blast of Jahannam.”
items.ma-8225: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Let none of you sell over the sale of his brother, and let none of you propose over the proposal of his brother.”
items.ma-8226: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The disbeliever eats in seven intestines, and the believer eats in one intestine.”
items.ma-8233: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “How excellent it is for the slave to die with good worship of Allah and good companionship of his master; how excellent it is for him!”
items.ma-8925: Qutaybah narrated to us, Layth ibn Saʿd narrated to us, Ibn al-Hādī narrated to us, and he mentioned like it; he did not say: he heard the Prophet ﷺ.
items.ma-8978: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Suhayl, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, with the like of all this speech.
items.ma-9100: Ibn Mahdī narrated to us, from Mālik, from al-Mughīrah ibn Abī Burdah.
items.ma-9288: He said: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever stands [in prayer] during Ramaḍān out of īmān and iḥtisāb, what preceded of his sin is forgiven for him.”
items.ma-9400: And he said: “Whoever takes walāʾ with a people without the permission of his mawālī, upon him is the curse of Allah and the angels; Allah will not accept from him ṣarf or ʿadl.”
items.ma-9450: Abū Muʿāwiyah and Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, they said: al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Saʿīd, from the Prophet ﷺ, and the two mentioned it.
items.ma-9541: Makkī narrated to us with this isnād, and he said: “Allah freed, for every limb of it, a limb from the Fire.”
items.ma-9544: Yazīd ibn Hārūn and Yaʿlā narrated to us, they said: Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, like it, regarding the black seed.
items.ma-9812: Yazīd narrated to us, Muḥammad informed us, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “This minbar of mine is upon a turʿah of the turaʿ of Paradise.”
items.ma-10082: Yazīd narrated to us, Sufyān informed us, from Ḥabīb, from Ibn al-Muṭawwis, from his father, and he mentioned it.
items.ma-10113: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr, he said: Salmān al-Agharr narrated to us, [that] he heard Abū Hurayrah narrating from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-10139: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Hishām, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “A woman is not married over her paternal aunt, nor over her maternal aunt.”
items.ma-10143: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr, he said: Abū Salamah narrated to us, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Disputation about the Qurʾān is kufr.”
items.ma-10185: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Ibn Abī Laylā narrated to us, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Take the pre-dawn meal, for in the pre-dawn meal there is blessing.”
items.ma-10426: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, he said: al-Aʿmash informed us, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-10574: And Rawḥ narrated it to us with its isnād and its meaning, and he said: “before it is taken from him, when there is no dīnār and no dirham.”
items.ma-10602: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim al-Aḥwal, from Abū Ḥassān al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, like it.
items.ma-10660: Abū Aḥmad narrated to us with his isnād, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, Abū Hurayrah narrated to us, he said: until the two entered upon their mother.
items.ma-11061: Al-Ḥakam ibn Mūsā narrated to us, Ibn Abī al-Rijāl narrated to us, similar to it.
items.ma-11236: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed Paradise has one hundred degrees; if the worlds were gathered in one of them, it would hold them.”
items.ma-11240: He said: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The most truthful of dreams are at the pre-dawn times.”
items.ma-11518: Abū al-Naḍr narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, like it.
items.ma-11576: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Sufyān, Shuʿbah and Mālik, from ʿAmr ibn Yaḥyā, from his father, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-11718: And from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he said: “Indeed gatherings are three: one who is safe, one who gains, and one who is ruined.”
items.ma-11789: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, and he said: from Abū Saʿīd, as he reckoned, from the Prophet ﷺ.
items.ma-11945: Hushaym narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Prophet ﷺ prayed in a cloak of ḥibarah; he said: I reckon he tied between its two ends.
items.ma-11952: Hushaym narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, Anas ibn Mālik narrated to us, he said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ took Ṣafiyyah, he stayed with her for three [nights], and she was a thayyib.
items.ma-11990: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz narrated to us, from Anas, he said: The Prophet ﷺ used to shorten the prayer and complete it.
items.ma-12001: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb narrated to us, Ayyūb narrated to us, from Abū Qilābah, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: Bilāl was commanded to double the adhān and to make the iqāmah single.
items.ma-12076: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Anas, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “When supper is served and the prayer is called, begin with supper.”
items.ma-12118: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Ḥumayd al-Ṭawīl informed us, from Anas, he said: The hair of the Prophet ﷺ reached to the middle of his ears.
items.ma-12164: Abū Usāmah narrated to us, he said: Sharīk informed me, from ʿĀṣim al-Aḥwal, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: “O possessor of the two ears.”
