items.ma-12410: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, he said: Sharīk narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim, he said: I saw with Anas the cup of the Prophet ﷺ, on which there was a ḍabbah of silver.
items.ma-12435: Khalaf narrated to us, al-Mubārak narrated to us, Thābit narrated to me, from Anas, he said: When Fāṭimah said, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-12456: Bahz narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas: that three men went off, and he mentioned its meaning, and he did not raise it.
items.ma-12576: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, he said: I saw with Anas ibn Mālik a cup that had belonged to the Prophet ﷺ, on which there was a ḍabbah of silver.
items.ma-12620: Sulaymān narrated to us, Ismāʿīl informed us, he said: Ḥumayd informed me, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ, when the wind blew, it was recognised in his face.
items.ma-12640: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, he said: Maʿmar informed us, from Qatādah, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to go around to his wives with a single ghusl.
items.ma-12686: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Thābit, Abān and more than one, from Anas, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “There is no shighār in Islam.”
items.ma-12842: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was among the lightest of people in prayer, while being complete.
items.ma-12879: Yaḥyā narrated to us, Ashʿath narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from Anas, similar to it, like it.
items.ma-12893: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ slaughtered, and pronounced the name and said takbīr.
items.ma-12909-2: He said: And when the Prophet ﷺ went out to fight, he would say: “O Allah, You are my support, and You are my helper, and by You I fight.”
items.ma-12914: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed in the house of Umm Ḥarām on a rug.
items.ma-12916: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-12931: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, from Thābit, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-12946: ʿAbd al-Aʿlā narrated to us, from Yaḥyā, from Anas, he said: We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to Makkah, and I heard him say: “Labbayka, ʿumrah and Ḥajj.”
items.ma-13061: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Zayd narrated to us, from Salm al-ʿAlawī, from Anas ibn Mālik, that the Prophet ﷺ said to him: “O my little son.”
items.ma-13152: Rawḥ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, he said: I heard Manṣūr say: I heard Ṭalq ibn Ḥabīb narrating from Anas ibn Mālik, from the Prophet ﷺ, with the like of it.
items.ma-13158: Aswad narrated to us, Abū Bakr narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed qunūt for twenty days.
items.ma-13245: Muḥammad ibn Bakr narrated to us, Saʿīd informed us, from Qatādah, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Take the pre-dawn meal, for in the pre-dawn meal there is blessing.”
items.ma-13341: Abū al-Mughīrah narrated to us, Ṣafwān ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, from ʿUthmān ibn Jābir, from Anas ibn Mālik, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “War is deception.”
items.ma-13449: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb narrated to us, Saʿīd informed us, from Qatādah, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, with the like of it.
items.ma-13634: ʿAffān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, similar to it.
items.ma-13762: ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Muḥammad narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, like it.
items.ma-13802: Mūsā ibn Dāwūd narrated to us, Zuhayr narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: The ring of the Prophet ﷺ was of silver, its bezel from it.
items.ma-13878: Hushaym narrated to us, Shuʿbah informed us, from Qatādah, he said: Anas informed us, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to sacrifice two rams, and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-14120: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: I saw the Prophet ﷺ praying in a single garment.
items.ma-14218: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir: that the Prophet ﷺ hastened in the valley of Muḥassir.
items.ma-14263: Hushaym narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the one who consumes ribā, the one who feeds it, its two witnesses, and its writer.
items.ma-14294: Sufyān narrated to us, Ibn al-Munkadir said: I heard Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was never asked for anything, and said: No.
items.ma-14312: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAmr, from Jābir, from the Prophet ﷺ: “Allah will bring out a people from the Fire and admit them into Paradise.”
items.ma-14318: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAmr, from Jābir: We used to practise ʿazl in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while the Qurʾān was being revealed.
items.ma-14349: Ḥasan narrated to us, Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “There is no ṭiyarah, no contagion, and no ghūl.”
items.ma-14371: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, Ḥajjāj narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that date palms be sold for two years and three.
items.ma-14396: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “When one of you has fulfilled,” and he mentioned it.
items.ma-14437: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, Abū al-Zubayr informed me that he heard Jābir say: I saw the Prophet ﷺ throw the jamrah with pebbles of khadhf.
items.ma-14748: Mūsā narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, that he informed him: that the Prophet ﷺ was the most lightening of people in the prayer.
items.ma-14904: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr informed us, from Jābir: that the Prophet ﷺ entered on the day of the conquest of Makkah wearing a black turban.
items.ma-14905: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ cauterised Saʿd ibn Muʿādh for [the wound of] his shot.
items.ma-14968: He said: And the Prophet of Allah ﷺ forbade a mixture of unripe dates and dates, and of raisins and dates.
items.ma-15007: Ḥammād ibn Khālid narrated to us, from Mālik, from Jaʿfar, from his father, from Jābir: that the Prophet ﷺ performed ramal from the Stone to the Stone.
items.ma-15050: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Sufyān, from Jābir, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The people are followers of Quraysh in good and in evil.”
items.ma-15086: Yaḥyā ibn Yamān narrated to us, from al-Muthannā, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Jābir: that the Prophet ﷺ performed a single ṭawāf.
items.ma-15240: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Jābir, that he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “The servant is with the one he loves.”
items.ma-15250: And Jābir said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us from al-ṭurūq when we came back from a journey.
items.ma-15329-2: ʿAṭāʾ said: And ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿIṣmah al-Jushamī also informed me of it, that he heard Ḥakīm ibn Ḥizām narrating it from the Prophet ﷺ.
items.ma-15350: Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from al-Rabīʿ ibn Sabrah, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the marriage of mutʿah.
items.ma-16114: Yaḥyā and Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Hishām ibn ʿUrwah, mursal.
items.ma-16405: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Misʿar narrated to us, from al-Naḍr ibn Qays, he said: I heard Yūsuf ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Salām say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ named me Yūsuf.
items.ma-16732: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Muḥammad ibn Jubayr ibn Muṭʿim, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “No one who severs will enter Paradise.”
items.ma-16956: Al-Haytham ibn Khārijah narrated to us, Ismāʿīl ibn ʿAyyāsh narrated to us, from Shuraḥbīl ibn Muslim, and he mentioned the like of this hadith.
items.ma-17058: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, he said: Maʿmar narrated to us, he said: Ibn Shihāb narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUtbah, the meaning.
items.ma-17104: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, he said: I heard Sulaymān say: I heard ʿUmārah ibn ʿUmayr, like it.
items.ma-17230: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, and he mentioned it with its isnād and its meaning. He said: So I went out early to him in a red ḥullah.
items.ma-17292: Hushaym narrated to us, Yūnus informed me, from al-Ḥasan, from ʿUqbah ibn ʿĀmir al-Juhanī, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “There is no ʿuhdah after four.”
items.ma-17579: Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, Ismāʿīl narrated to us, from Qays, from Dukayn ibn Saʿīd, he said: We came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he mentioned the hadith.
items.ma-17837: Muḥammad ibn Bakr narrated to us, he said: Saʿīd informed us, from Qatādah, from Anas ibn Mālik, from Mālik ibn Ṣaʿṣaʿah, a man from his people, and he mentioned it.
items.ma-18188: Mūsā ibn Dāwūd narrated to us, from Qabīṣah ibn Jābir, from al-Mughīrah.
items.ma-18256: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from al-Ḥakam, from al-Shaʿbī, from ʿAdī ibn Ḥātim, from the Prophet ﷺ: like that.
items.ma-18342: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, with this isnād, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The two who revile one another are two Shayṭāns, who lie to one another and speak foolishness to one another.”
items.ma-18505: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from al-Ashʿath ibn Sulaym. And he mentioned its meaning, except that he said: the naming of the one who sneezes.
items.ma-18507: Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān said: And ʿUbayd Allāh al-Qawārīrī narrated to me, he said: Muʿādh ibn Hishām narrated to us. And he mentioned the like of it with its isnād.
items.ma-18559: Wakīʿ narrated to us, my father narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ went on fifteen campaigns.
items.ma-18562: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Murrah, from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib: that the Prophet ﷺ stoned.
items.ma-18765: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Isrāʾīl, from Abū Isḥāq, he said: I heard Abū Juḥayfah say: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ pray two rakʿahs at Minā.
items.ma-18772: And ʿĪsā ibn Yūnus said: from Jābir ibn Samurah al-Suwāʾī – ʿAlī ibn Baḥr narrated it to us from him – he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ pointing with his finger.
items.ma-18843: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, he said: And Shuʿbah said: and he lowered his voice with it.
items.ma-18948: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Abū al-ʿUshārāʾ, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it. He said: And I heard him say: “By your father.”
items.ma-19071: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh, with the hadith of the sun.
items.ma-19085: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl, from Qays, from al-Ṣunābiḥī al-Aḥmasī, like it.
items.ma-19170: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Zayd ibn Wahb, from Jarīr ibn ʿAbd Allāh, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said; and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-19448: Abū al-Yamān narrated to us, he said: Abū Bakr ibn ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, from ʿAṭiyyah ibn Qays, from ʿAmr ibn ʿAbasah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like that.
items.ma-19615: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abān narrated to us with both of these, from Qatādah, from Anas, from Abū Mūsā, from the Prophet ﷺ, similar to it.
items.ma-19949: Hawdhah narrated to us, from ʿAwf, from Abū Rajāʾ, mursal. And likewise said another besides him.
items.ma-20036: Yūnus narrated to us, from Ḥammād ibn Zayd, he said also: And the Prophet ﷺ said with his hand, and placed it on his private part.
items.ma-20131: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Upon the hand is what it has taken until it pays it back.”
items.ma-20251: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Qatādah and Ḥumayd, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The neighbour has more right to the neighbouring.”
items.ma-20370: Wahb ibn Jarīr narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Abū Iyās, from his father: that he came to the Prophet ﷺ, and he supplicated for him and wiped his head.
items.ma-20822: He said: And I heard him say: “Indeed Allah named Madinah Ṭaybah.”
items.ma-20886: And with this isnād, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had two khuṭbahs, between which he would sit, reciting the Qurʾān and reminding the people.
items.ma-21025: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Simāk ibn Ḥarb, from Jābir ibn Samurah, he said: The prayer of the Prophet ﷺ was moderate, and his khuṭbah was moderate.
items.ma-21051: ʿUmar ibn ʿUbayd narrated to us, from Simāk, from Jābir ibn Samurah, he said: I never saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ give a khuṭbah except standing.
items.ma-21254: And he said: “If not for the Hijrah, I would have been a man of the Anṣār; and if the Anṣār took a valley – or he said: a mountain pass – I would be of the Anṣār.”
items.ma-21422: And Ibn Jaʿfar: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Sulaymān, he said: I heard Ibrāhīm al-Taymī, and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-21521: And Hārūn narrated it to us, Ibn Wahb narrated to us, Ḥarmalah narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Shimāsah, he said: I heard Abū Dharr, and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-21708: Yazīd ibn Hārūn and Yaʿlā narrated to us, they said: ʿAbd al-Malik narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Ṣafwān – Yazīd said: ibn ʿAbd Allāh – and he mentioned it.
items.ma-21775: Surayj narrated to us, Qays narrated to us, from Jāmiʿ … except that he said: So they entered upon him while he was wrapped in a cloak of his of Maʿāfir, and he did not say: and the Christians.
items.ma-21797: Abū Qaṭan narrated to us, al-Masʿūdī narrated to us, from Abū Jaʿfar, from Usāmah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed in the Kaʿbah.
items.ma-22556: Abū al-Naḍr narrated to us, Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd narrated to us, my father narrated to me, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Qatādah, from his father, and he mentioned something similar.
items.ma-22796: Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū Ḥāzim, from Sahl ibn Saʿd, from the Prophet ﷺ, that he said: “I and the Hour were sent like this one from this one.”
items.ma-22827: Nūḥ ibn Maymūn narrated to us, Mālik informed us, from Ibn Shihāb, Sahl ibn Saʿd informed me, from the Prophet ﷺ: that he disliked questions and found fault with them.
items.ma-22843: Abū Nūḥ narrated to us, Mālik ibn Anas narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Sahl ibn Saʿd, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ disliked questions and found fault with them.
items.ma-22953: Yazīd narrated to us, al-Jurayrī informed us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Buraydah: that his father went on sixteen campaigns with the Prophet ﷺ.
items.ma-23080: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Khālid al-Ḥadhdhāʾ, from Ibn al-Shikhkhīr, from the Bedouin: that the sandal of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was patched.
items.ma-23270: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Ḥabīb ibn Sulaym al-ʿAbsī, from Bilāl ibn Yaḥyā al-ʿAbsī, from Ḥudhayfah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade al-naʿy.
items.ma-23292: Fazārah ibn ʿUmar narrated to us, Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd narrated to us, Ṣāliḥ ibn Kaysān narrated to us, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-23424: Abū al-Naḍr narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Ḥammād, he said: I heard Ribʿī ibn Ḥirāsh narrating from the Prophet ﷺ, and he mentioned it.
items.ma-23623: And with this isnād, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed Allah, when He Aḥabba a people, tests them; whoever is patient, for him is patience, and whoever is impatient, for him is impatience.”
items.ma-24082: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Abū Salamah, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Every drink that intoxicates is ḥarām.”
items.ma-24120: Sufyān narrated to us, from Hishām, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah – she conveys it to the Prophet ﷺ: “When supper is placed and the prayer is called, begin with supper.”
items.ma-24243: Yaḥyā narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, my father narrated to me, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-25035: Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Ibrāhīm, from Hammām, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I used to rub it.
items.ma-25075: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Prophet ﷺ scraped off spittle in the mosque.
items.ma-25595: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Aswad ibn Yazīd, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Prophet ﷺ would not perform wuḍūʾ after ghusl.
items.ma-25692: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Hishām ibn ʿUrwah narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Prophet ﷺ used to lighten the two rakʿahs of the Fajr.
items.ma-25724: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Aflaḥ narrated to us, from al-Qāsim, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I perfumed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with these two hands of mine at the time of iḥrām.
items.ma-25725: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Hishām, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I perfumed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with the most fragrant of what I could find.
items.ma-25732: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Prophet ﷺ kissed one of his wives while he was fasting. Then she laughed.
items.ma-25762: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from Jābir, from Zayd al-ʿAmmī, from Abū al-Ṣiddīq, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Prophet ﷺ washed his seat three times.
items.ma-25846: Isḥāq ibn Yūsuf narrated to us, from Sharīk, from al-Aʿmash, from Ibrāhīm, from ʿUmārah, from his paternal aunt, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-26266: Abū Qaṭan narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from al-Ḥakam, from Ibrāhīm, from Hammām ibn al-Ḥārith, from ʿĀʾishah, like its meaning.
items.ma-26273: ʿAlī narrated to us, from Yazīd ibn Abī Ziyād, from Mujāhid, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: I saw the shine of perfume in the parting of the hair of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was in iḥrām.
items.ma-26890: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid, from Umm Hāniʾ, she said: The Prophet ﷺ came to Makkah once, and he had four braids.
items.ma-27037: Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, he said: Saʿīd – meaning Ibn Abī Ayyūb – narrated to us, he said: Abū al-Aswad narrated to me, and he mentioned it.
items.ma-27565: Wakīʿ narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd narrated to us, from Shahr ibn Ḥawshab, from Asmāʾ, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ died while his armour was pawned.
items.ma-4468: Muʿtamir narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to place his mount broadside, and pray toward it.
items.ma-4529: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Mālik, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Prophet ﷺ stoned a Jewish man and a Jewish woman.
items.ma-4542: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from his father: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ combine the Maghrib and the ʿIshāʾ [prayers] when the journey became urgent for him.
items.ma-4562: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār, from Ibn ʿUmar: The Prophet ﷺ was asked about the desert lizard, and he said: “I do not eat it, and I do not prohibit it.”
items.ma-4615: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ narrated to me, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ: “A woman must not travel for three [days] unless she has with her a mahram.”
items.ma-4644: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr, from Abū Salamah, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Every intoxicant is forbidden.”
items.ma-4723: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ informed me, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Ahead of you is a Ḥawḍ, [as wide as] what is between Jarbāʾ and Adhruḥ.”
items.ma-4779: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Ḥanẓalah narrated to us, from Sālim, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited that the ṣūrah be struck, meaning the face.
items.ma-4889: He said: Maʿmar narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ shaved [his head] during his Ḥajj.
items.ma-4940: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, he said: I read to Ibn Jurayj: Ziyād – meaning Ibn Saʿd – narrated to me, from Ibn Shihāb, from Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar, like it.
items.ma-4974: ʿUthmān ibn ʿUthmān narrated to us, ʿUmar ibn Nāfiʿ narrated to us, from his father, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited al-qazaʿ.
items.ma-5196: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ: He prohibited that livestock be milked without the permission of their owners.
items.ma-5204: Rawḥ narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh ibn al-Akhnas informed us, Nāfiʿ informed me, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar, and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-5219: Wakīʿ narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Nāfiʿ narrated to me, from his father, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-5348: ʿAttāb narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿUmar informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ held a race with horses and made a wager.
items.ma-5352: ʿAlī ibn Isḥāq narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh informed us, Mūsā ibn ʿUqbah informed us, and he mentioned the like of it with its chain of narration.
items.ma-5367: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Zayd narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Respond to the invitation when you are invited.”
items.ma-5456: Ḥasan narrated to us, Shaybān narrated to us, from Yaḥyā, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever comes to the Jumuʿah, let him perform ghusl.”
items.ma-5459: Isḥāq ibn Sulaymān narrated to us, Mālik informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stoned a Jewish man and a Jewish woman.
items.ma-5588: Hushaym narrated to us, Ibn Abī Laylā informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ used to make the horses lean.
items.ma-5685: Muḥammad ibn Bishr narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: On the ring of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ [was inscribed]: Muḥammad, Messenger of Allah.
items.ma-5769: ʿAffān narrated to us, he said: Ḥammād narrated to us, from Suhayl, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-6108: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Zayd narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “Come to the invitation when you are invited.”
items.ma-6297: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ apportioned two shares for the horse and one share for the man.
items.ma-6336: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited the killing of the jinnān.
items.ma-6344: Yaʿqūb narrated to us, my father narrated to us, from Ṣāliḥ, Ibn Shihāb said: Ḥamzah ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar narrated to me, and he mentioned it.
items.ma-6452: Ḥammād ibn Khālid narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The walāʾ belongs to the one who freed.”
items.ma-6455: Ḥammād narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “By twenty-seven,” meaning the congregational prayer.
items.ma-6459: Ḥammād narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh said: Nāfiʿ narrated to us, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ: that he disliked al-qazaʿ for boys.
items.ma-6826: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Misʿar narrated to us, from Abū Ḥaṣīn, from al-Qāsim ibn Mukhaymirah, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-7175: Muḥammad ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Hishām, from Ibn Sīrīn, he said: I heard Abū Hurayrah say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited al-ikhtiṣār in the prayer.
items.ma-7272: ʿAlī ibn Isḥāq narrated to us, from Ibn al-Mubārak, from Ibn Abī Ḥafṣah.
items.ma-7377: It was read to Sufyān: I heard Ayyūb, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “Name yourselves with my name, and do not use my kunyah.”
items.ma-7385: Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, and he added to it: and he would turn away to his right and to his left.
items.ma-7602: ʿAbd al-Razzāq said: And ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Būdhawayh informed me that Maʿmar used to mention it with this chain of narration, and he would mention it from ʿUbayd Allāh.
items.ma-7636: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar informed us, from Ayyūb, from Ibn Sīrīn, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, similar to the narration of Abū Salamah.
items.ma-7774: ʿAlī ibn Isḥāq narrated to us, from Ibn al-Mubārak, from Yūnus, from al-Zuhrī, from Abū Umāmah.
items.ma-8046: He said: “And he continued to enjoin me concerning the neighbour, until I thought – or I saw – that he would make him an heir.”
items.ma-8048: Abū Qaṭan narrated to us, Yūnus narrated to us, from Mujāhid, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited the foul medicine.
items.ma-8127: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When Allah decreed the creation, He wrote a book, and it is with Him Fawq al-ʿArsh: Indeed, My raḥmah has prevailed over My Ghaḍab.”
items.ma-8153:
And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed Allah ﷿ said to me: Spend, and I will spend on you.”
And he named war deception.
items.ma-8204: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Glorification is for the men, and clapping is for the women, in the prayer.”
items.ma-8229: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed Allah does not Yanẓuru ilā the one who lets his garment trail on the Day of Resurrection.”
items.ma-8232: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Let the son of Ādam not say: O the disappointment of al-Dahr! Indeed I am al-Dahr; I send the night and the day, and when I will, I seize them both.”
items.ma-8243: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The people are followers of Quraysh in this matter: their Muslim follows their Muslim, and their disbeliever follows their disbeliever.”
items.ma-8244: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The best of women who have ridden camels are the righteous women of Quraysh: the most tender toward a child in its infancy, and the most watchful over a husband in what is in his possession.”
items.ma-8247: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The upper hand is better than the lower hand, and begin with those whom you support.”
items.ma-8252: And he said: “The wound caused by a dumb beast is jubār, the mine is jubār, the well is jubār, and in the rikāz is the khumus.”
items.ma-8329: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “May Allah have mercy on Lūṭ; he used to take refuge in a strong pillar. And if I had remained in prison as long as Yūsuf remained, I would have answered the caller.”
items.ma-8571-3: He said: And Abū Hurayrah said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited the earnings of the cupper, and the earnings of the slave-woman.
items.ma-8806: Rawḥ ibn ʿUbādah narrated to us, he said: Ibn Abī Dhiʾb informed us, meaning like it.
items.ma-9085: And Ibn Numayr narrated it to us, from al-Aʿmash, with its meaning.
items.ma-9180: ʿAbdah – he is Ibn Sulaymān – narrated to us, he said: Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr narrated to us; and he mentioned the like of it with its chain of narration.
items.ma-9478-2: And likewise – meaning – Ibn Fuḍayl said also.
items.ma-9579: Yaḥyā narrated to us, he said: Usāmah narrated to us, from Makḥūl, from ʿIrāk, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-9581: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ibn ʿAjlān, he said: I heard my father, from Abū Hurayrah: The Prophet ﷺ heard the voice of a boy in the prayer, so he shortened the prayer.
items.ma-9708: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: ʿĪsā ibn al-Musayyib narrated to us, from Abū Zurʿah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The cat is a predator.”
items.ma-10038: He said: “And Qayṣar will perish, and there will be no Qayṣar after him; and Kisrā will perish, and there will be no Kisrā after him.”
items.ma-10152: “And the odour from the mouth of the fasting person is better-smelling with Allah than the scent of musk.”
items.ma-10199: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from ʿĀṣim ibn Kulayb, from his father, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: I did not see the Messenger of Allah ﷺ pray the Ḍuḥā except once.
items.ma-10208: He said: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “A woman tied a cat – or a she-cat – and did not feed it, nor did she let it eat from the creatures of the earth, so she was made to enter the Fire.”
items.ma-10235: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ṣāliḥ, the mawlā of al-Tawʾamah, from Abū Hurayrah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “A town-dweller must not sell for a desert-dweller.”
items.ma-10366: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “A town-dweller does not sell for a desert-dweller.”
items.ma-10387: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, he said: ʿAwf narrated to us, from Khilās, from Abū Rāfiʿ, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, like that.
items.ma-10389: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, he said: ʿAwf narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like that.
items.ma-10393: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, he said: ʿAwf narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like that.
items.ma-10671: Rawḥ narrated to us, ʿAwf narrated to us, from Khilās ibn ʿAmr, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-11001: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Abū Naḍrah, from Abū Saʿīd, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The Witr is by night.”
items.ma-11037: Yazīd ibn Hārūn said, from Hishām, from Yaḥyā, from Hilāl, from Abū Saʿīd: It kills ḥabaṭan or khabṭan, and it is only ḥabaṭan.
items.ma-11173: Ḥusayn narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, Anas ibn Sīrīn informed us, from his brother Maʿbad; and he mentioned something similar.
items.ma-11230-2: And from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: “If a bucket of ghassāq were poured out in the world, it would make the people of the world stink.”
items.ma-11233: And from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he said: “If a mace of iron were placed on the earth, and the two thaqalān gathered for it, they could not lift it from the earth.”
items.ma-11234: And from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, that he said: “The surādiq of the Fire has four thick walls, each wall the like of a journey of forty years.”
items.ma-11238: And indeed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “By Him in whose hand is my soul, even the two sheep will dispute over what they butted each other for.”
items.ma-11321: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated it to us, from Hishām, from Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr, from ʿIyāḍ, that he asked Abū Saʿīd; and he mentioned it.
items.ma-11553: Al-Khuzāʿī – meaning Abū Salamah – narrated to us, except that he said: laṣaʿiqa.
items.ma-11653: And with this chain of narration, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Increase the remembrance of Allah until they say: He is mad.”
items.ma-11727: And with this chain of narration, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever swears an oath, then sees something better than it, then its kaffārah is to leave it.”
items.ma-11951: Hushaym narrated to us, from Ḥumayd al-Ṭawīl, he said: I heard Anas ibn Mālik say: I saw the ring of the Prophet ﷺ [and it was] of silver.
items.ma-11993: Muḥammad ibn Fuḍayl narrated to us, al-Aʿmash informed us, from Anas, he said: The armour of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was pawned; he did not find [anything] with which to redeem it until he died.
items.ma-12084: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Qatādah, from Anas, he said: I prayed behind the Prophet ﷺ, and Abū Bakr and ʿUmar, and they used to begin with al-ḥamd.
items.ma-12094: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ibn Judʿān, he said: Thābit said to Anas: O Anas, did you touch the hand of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with your hand? He said: Yes. He said: Show it to me so that I may kiss it.
items.ma-12206: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Misʿar, from ʿAmr ibn ʿĀmir, he said: I heard Anas say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was cupped, and he would not wrong anyone of [his] wage.
items.ma-12229: Yazīd narrated to us, Hammām ibn Yaḥyā informed us, from Qatādah, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The two sandals of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ each had two straps.
items.ma-12265: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Anas: that the hair of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to strike his shoulder.
items.ma-12283: Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Muqriʾ narrated to us, Jarīr narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas, he said: The recitation of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was a prolongation; he would prolong it with a prolongation.
items.ma-12407: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ used to gesture in the prayer.
items.ma-12632: Abū Kāmil narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Prophet ﷺ went around to all his wives in one day.
items.ma-12660: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar informed us, from Thābit, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The Hour will not be established upon anyone who says: Allah, Allah.”
items.ma-12687: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ freed Ṣafiyyah, and made her freeing her dowry.
items.ma-12844: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-ʿUmarī narrated to us, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Ṭalḥah, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ prayed on a mat.
items.ma-12878: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: I did not see anyone more complete in prayer than the Prophet ﷺ, nor more concise.
items.ma-12899: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Muṣʿab ibn Sulaym narrated to us, he said: I heard Anas say: The Prophet ﷺ pronounced the ihlāl for a Ḥajj and an ʿumrah.
items.ma-12901: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Sufyān, from one who heard Anas say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by Saʿd while he was supplicating with two fingers, and he said: “Make it one, O Saʿd.”
items.ma-12967: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Ḥumayd narrated to us, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ went around to his wives in one night with one ghusl.
items.ma-13002: Bahz narrated to us, Jarīr narrated to us, he said: I heard Qatādah say: I said to Anas: How was the recitation of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ? He said: He would extend his voice with an extension.
items.ma-13054: ʿAbd al-Aʿlā narrated to us, from Maʿmar, from al-Zuhrī, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: Al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī was the most like them in face to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-13102: Yazīd narrated to us, Hammām informed us, from Qatādah, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Prophet ﷺ had two sandals, each with two straps.
items.ma-13126: Ibn Abī ʿAdī narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was among the lightest – or most complete – of people in prayer, and the most concise of them.
items.ma-13216: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw phlegm in the qiblah of the mosque, and scraped it with his hand.
items.ma-13342: Abū al-Yamān narrated to us, Ṣafwān ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, from ʿUthmān ibn Jābir, from Anas ibn Mālik, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he said: “War is deception.”
items.ma-13414: Asbāṭ ibn Muḥammad narrated to us, Saʿīd narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas ibn Mālik, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was among the lightest of people in prayer, while being complete.
items.ma-13431: ʿAlī narrated to us, from Ḥanẓalah al-Sadūsī, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed qunūt for a month after the bowing in the morning prayer, supplicating.
items.ma-13601:
ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah.
From Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ performed qunūt for a month, then left it.
items.ma-13647: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, Thābit informed us, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw phlegm in the qiblah of the mosque, and scraped it with his hand.
items.ma-13651: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, like this.
items.ma-13691: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas ibn Mālik, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-13738: Aswad narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ said to him: “O possessor of the two ears.”
items.ma-13759: Sulaymān narrated to us, Ismāʿīl informed us, he said: Al-ʿAlāʾ ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān informed me, from Anas, like it.
items.ma-13956: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ slaughtered, and said the name [of Allah] and pronounced the takbīr.
items.ma-14062: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād and Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Anas, similar to the narration of Ḥammād.
items.ma-14066: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abū al-Mundhir Sallām narrated to us, and he mentioned it.
items.ma-14104: Bahz narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Prophet ﷺ freed Ṣafiyyah, and made her freeing her dowry.
items.ma-14151: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb narrated to us, from Saʿīd, from Qatādah, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Jābir, and he mentioned the ḥadīth. And he said: The name of al-Najāshī was Ṣaḥmah.
items.ma-14304: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Aswad, from Nubayḥ, from Jābir: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited us from coming upon women at night, then we came upon them [at night] afterward.
items.ma-14351: Ḥasan narrated to us, Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever commits plunder is not of us.”
items.ma-14429: Yaḥyā narrated to us, Ibn Abī ʿArūbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Jābir, from the Prophet ﷺ, similar to it, like it. Thus said Yaḥyā.
items.ma-14648: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj narrated to us: Abū al-Zubayr informed me that he heard Jābir ibn ʿAbd Allāh say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited al-shighār.
items.ma-14756: Mūsā narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir, he said: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: “The sun rises on the horn of a shayṭān.”
items.ma-15076: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: ʿAmr heard Jābir say: My two ears heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: “A people will come out of the Fire and enter Paradise.”
items.ma-15078: Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, he heard Jābir say: We did not pledge allegiance to the Prophet ﷺ to death; rather we pledged allegiance to him that we would not flee.
items.ma-15079: Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, he heard Jābir say: The Prophet ﷺ was asked about the earnings of the cupper, and he said: “Feed it to your water-carrying camel.”
items.ma-15249: And he said: “If a woman impresses one of you, let him go to his wife, for that repels [it] from his self.”
items.ma-15328: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from the like of it. He said: “As long as the two have not separated.”
items.ma-15344: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from al-Rabīʿ ibn Sabrah, from his father, that the Prophet ﷺ prohibited the mutʿah of women.
items.ma-15373: Abū Nuʿaym narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Ḥabīb, from Khumayl, from Nāfiʿ ibn ʿAbd al-Ḥārith, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said; and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-15385: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, he said: Sharīk said: I asked the family of al-Ḥakam ibn Sufyān, and they mentioned that he did not meet the Prophet ﷺ.
items.ma-16115: Sulaymān ibn Ḥarb narrated to us, he said: Ḥammād ibn Zayd narrated to us, mursal; Ibn al-Zubayr is not in it.
items.ma-16255: He said: And I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “By Allah, between the creation of Ādam and the establishment of the Hour there is no matter greater than the Dajjāl.”
items.ma-16360: And Ḥusayn narrated to us, from Shaybān, and he did not give it a connected chain, from Abū Ṭalḥah, he said: And taqmiʾah.
items.ma-16545: Ḥammād ibn Masʿadah narrated to us, from Yazīd, from Salamah: that he asked permission of the Prophet ﷺ regarding the desert, and he permitted him.
items.ma-17387: Rawḥ narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj narrated to us, Yaḥyā ibn Ayyūb narrated to us, that Yazīd ibn Abī Ḥabīb informed him, and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-17400: And he said: “Indeed Allah ﷿ will cause three to enter Paradise by one arrow: its maker, the one who supplies it, and the one who shoots it in the way of Allah.”
items.ma-17740: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Abū Idrīs, from Abū Thaʿlabah al-Khushanī: that the Prophet ﷺ prohibited the eating of every predator possessing a fang.
items.ma-17963: Abū al-Rabīʿ al-Zahrānī narrated to us, Fulayḥ narrated to us, from Ibn Shihāb, from ʿAmr ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Umayyah, with his chain of narration, like it.
items.ma-17968: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Laylā, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Yaʿlā ibn Umayyah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed Allah Yuḥibbu modesty and concealment.”
items.ma-18121: ʿAffān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, al-Ḥakam informed us, from Ibn Abī Laylā, from Kaʿb ibn ʿUjrah, he said: It was revealed concerning me.
items.ma-18122: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Dāwūd, from al-Shaʿbī, from Ibn Abī Laylā, from Kaʿb ibn ʿUjrah, this ḥadīth.
items.ma-18187: Yazīd narrated to us, Sharīk informed us, from ʿAbd al-Malik, from Ḥuṣayn ibn ʿUqbah, from al-Mughīrah.
items.ma-18189: Abū al-Naḍr narrated it to us, he said: From Ḥuṣayn, from al-Mughīrah.
items.ma-18208: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Ziyād ibn ʿIlāqah, from al-Mughīrah ibn Shuʿbah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited reviling the dead.
items.ma-18264: Bahz narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, Simāk ibn Ḥarb narrated to us. And he mentioned it from the place of the hunting, and said: “Make the blood flow.”
items.ma-18554: Abū Nuʿaym narrated to us with his chain of narration and its meaning, except that he said: Thābit, from Ibn al-Barāʾ, from al-Barāʾ.
items.ma-18641: Yaḥyā and Ḥusayn narrated to us, they said: Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Barāʾ, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed ʿumrah in Dhū al-Qaʿdah.
items.ma-18695: Hawdhah narrated to us, ʿAwf narrated to us, from Maymūn, he said: Al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib al-Anṣārī informed me. And he mentioned it.
items.ma-18754: Abū Nuʿaym narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAlī ibn al-Aqmar, he said: Abū Juḥayfah informed me, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “I do not eat reclining.”
items.ma-18841: ʿAbd al-Quddūs narrated to us, al-Ḥajjāj informed us, from ʿAbd al-Jabbār, from his father, that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say: “Āmīn.”
items.ma-19109: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Khālid, he said: I heard Ibn Abī Awfā say: If there were to be a prophet after the Prophet ﷺ, his son Ibrāhīm would not have died.
items.ma-19159: ʿAffān narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Wāḥid narrated to us, Ḥajjāj ibn Arṭāh narrated to us, ʿUthmān al-Bajalī narrated to us, from Zādhān; and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-19323: Bahz narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, Qatādah informed me, from al-Naḍr ibn Anas, from Zayd ibn Arqam, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said; and he mentioned the like of it.
items.ma-19533: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Wāʾil, from Abū Mūsā, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “A man is with the one he loves.”
items.ma-19572: He said: And when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent one of his Companions on some of his affairs, he would say: “Give glad tidings and do not drive away, and make easy and do not make difficult.”
items.ma-19924: Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān said: Hudbah narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn: that the Prophet ﷺ stoned.
items.ma-20007: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn: that the Prophet ﷺ had stoned.
items.ma-20066: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Saʿīd narrated to us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Salamah ibn al-Muḥabbiq, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-20077: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from al-Jurayrī, from Abū Naḍrah, from a man of the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-20110: And from Samurah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “The dead person is punished for what is wailed over him.”
items.ma-20130: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever encloses a piece of land with a wall, then it is his.”
items.ma-20133: He said: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed, with the boy is his ʿaqīqah; it is slaughtered for him on his seventh day, and he is named, and his head is shaved.”
items.ma-20192: ʿAlī narrated to us, Muʿādh narrated to us, my father narrated to me, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah: that the Prophet of Allah ﷺ prohibited al-tabattul.
items.ma-20362: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, from Muʿāwiyah ibn Qurrah, from his father, he said: The Prophet ﷺ wiped over my head.
items.ma-20402: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUyaynah, my father informed me, from Abū Bakrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: “A people who have entrusted their affair to a woman will never succeed.”
items.ma-20444: Yūnus – meaning Ibn Muḥammad – narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Yūnus and Ḥumayd, from al-Ḥasan, from Abū Bakrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-20641: Hudbah narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, like it with its chain of narration.
items.ma-20857: And he said: The adhān was not given for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at the two ʿīds.
items.ma-20978: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to me, from Simāk, from Jābir ibn Samurah, he said: I saw it like the egg of a pigeon, and its colour was the colour of his body.
items.ma-20994: Abū Kāmil narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from Simāk, from Jābir ibn Samurah: that the Prophet ﷺ stoned a Jewish man and a Jewish woman.
items.ma-21062: And Ibn Jaʿfar: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Sulaymān, he said: I heard ʿUmārah, with its meaning.
items.ma-21995: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū Ḥaṣīn, from al-Aswad ibn Hilāl, from Muʿādh, similar to it.
items.ma-22097: ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Hudbah ibn Khālid narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Anas, from Muʿādh, from the Prophet ﷺ, similar to it or like it.
items.ma-22669: Hushaym narrated to us, from Khālid, he said: I heard Abū Qilābah narrate from Abū al-Ashʿath, from ʿUbādah ibn al-Ṣāmit, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-22712: Qutaybah narrated to us, like it; he said: “Allah has forbidden the Fire to him.”
items.ma-22797: Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū Ḥāzim, from Sahl ibn Saʿd, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “A place the size of a whip in Paradise is better than the world and what is in it.”
items.ma-22800: Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū Ḥāzim, from Sahl ibn Saʿd, he said: It was from the tamarisk of al-Ghābah. Meaning the minbar of the Prophet ﷺ.
items.ma-22916: Yaḥyā ibn Abī Bukayr and Abū al-Naḍr narrated to us, they said: Al-Ashjaʿī, or he said: Al-Ashʿarī.
items.ma-23420: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Ibrāhīm, from Hammām, from Ḥudhayfah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “A tale-carrier will not enter Paradise.”
items.ma-23597: Hārūn narrated to us, Ibn Wahb narrated to us, Ḥaywah informed me that al-Walīd ibn Abī al-Walīd informed him; and he mentioned it with its chain of narration and its meaning.
items.ma-23838: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Misʿar narrated to us, from al-Naḍr ibn Qays, he said: I heard Yūsuf ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Salām say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ named me Yūsuf.
items.ma-24091: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Indeed Allah ﷿ Yuḥibbu gentleness in all matters.”
items.ma-24100: Sufyān narrated to us, from Maʿmar, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah: The most beloved of drinks to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was the sweet, cold [drink].
items.ma-24136: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Ibrāhīm, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ: that he once sent sheep as a gift.
items.ma-24335: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah: The Prophet ﷺ heard a man reciting a verse, and he said: “﵀, he has reminded me of a verse that I had forgotten.”
items.ma-24711: Ḥasan ibn Mūsā narrated it to us, he said: And he does not leave a need, if he has one toward a woman, until the pilgrim returns.
items.ma-24772: Surayj narrated to us, he said: Nāfiʿ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Mulaykah, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever is called to account is punished.”
items.ma-25139: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, Jabr ibn Ḥabīb narrated to us, from Umm Kulthūm bint Abī Bakr, from ʿĀʾishah; and he mentioned something similar.
items.ma-25330: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar and al-Thawrī narrated to us, from Ayyūb; and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-25722: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Aflaḥ narrated to us, from al-Qāsim, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ pronouncing the ihlāl for the Ḥajj.
items.ma-25735: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Hishām ibn ʿUrwah narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah: that she used to comb the hair of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while she was menstruating.
items.ma-25813: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, from Yūnus, from al-Ḥasan, he said: ʿĀʾishah was asked about the character of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and she said: His character was the Qurʾān.
items.ma-25937: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Prophet ﷺ scraped from the qiblah mucus, or spittle, or phlegm.
items.ma-25975: Yazīd narrated to us, he said: Hammām informed us, from Qatādah, from Ṣafiyyah bint Shaybah. And he said: By the measure of a mudd, and by the measure of a ṣāʿ.
items.ma-26192: Ḥammād narrated to us, Aflaḥ narrated to us, from al-Qāsim, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would wake in the morning in a state of janābah, then he would perform ghusl and fast his day.
items.ma-26213: Hāshim narrated to us, he said: Sharīk narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would not perform wuḍūʾ after the ghusl.
items.ma-26322: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Saʿd ibn Ibrāhīm, from Ṭalḥah ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAwf, from ʿĀʾishah, like it.
items.ma-26324: Yaʿqūb narrated to us, he said: My father narrated to us, from his father, from ʿUrwah, that ʿĀʾishah said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was in my lap when death came upon him.
items.ma-26412: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zinād, from ʿAlī ibn Ḥusayn, from ʿĀʾishah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He used to kiss while he was fasting.
items.ma-27019: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Ḥasan, from Ibn ʿAqīl, from al-Rubayyiʿ bint Muʿawwidh: that the Prophet ﷺ performed wuḍūʾ, and put his two fingers into the hole of his two ears.
items.ma-27212: He said: And I heard him say to the people: “Whoever affirms the oneness of Allah, and disbelieves in what is worshipped besides Him, his property and his blood are forbidden, and his reckoning is with Allah ﷿.”
items.ma-27325: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Abū ʿĀṣim, from al-Shaʿbī, from Fāṭimah bint Qays, from the Prophet ﷺ, he mentioned Madīnah and said: “It is Ṭaybah.”
items.ma-27518: Yazīd narrated it to us, he said: Shuʿbah informed us, and he said: Al-Kaykhārānī.
items.ma-4467: Muʿtamir narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever carries weapons against us is not of us.”
items.ma-4503: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Ayyūb informed us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ cut [the hand] in the case of a shield whose price was three dirhams.
items.ma-4553: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Sālim, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ: “Whoever of you comes to the Friday [prayer], let him perform ghusl.”
items.ma-4560: Sufyān narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Dīnār narrated to me, he heard Ibn ʿUmar saying: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of walāʾ and its gifting.
items.ma-4614: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ narrated to me, from Ibn ʿUmar, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would plant the spear and pray towards it.
items.ma-4654: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ informed us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿUmar, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Trim the moustaches closely, and let the beards grow abundantly.”
items.ma-4710: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, Nāfiʿ narrated to me, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said: “Make the last of your prayer at night witr.”
items.ma-4712: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Mālik, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ: “When one of you is called to a walīmah, let him come to it.”
items.ma-4793: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Prophet ﷺ prayed towards his camel.
items.ma-4824: Rawḥ narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-4918: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Ayyūb, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “There is no shighār in Islam.”
items.ma-4956: Qurrān ibn Tammām narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would pray on his mount wherever it turned with him.
items.ma-5139: ʿAbd Allāh [ibn Aḥmad] said: My father said: And ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Walīd said: Sufyān narrated to us, ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAlqamah narrated to us.
items.ma-5199: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ would come to the Mosque of Qubāʾ riding and walking.
items.ma-5230: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-ʿUmarī narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ entered Makkah by day.
items.ma-5231: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-ʿUmarī narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ would enter by the upper mountain pass and leave by the lower.
items.ma-5300: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Mālik, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ stoned a Jewish man and a Jewish woman.
items.ma-5307: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Mālik, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade the sale of ḥabal al-ḥabalah.
items.ma-5310: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Mālik, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, from the Prophet ﷺ: that he cut [the hand] in the case of a shield whose price was three dirhams.
items.ma-5510: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd al-Umawī narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of ḥabal al-ḥabalah.
items.ma-5543: Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Ayyūb narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ cut [the hand] in the case of a shield whose price was three dirhams.
items.ma-5603: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Mālik, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ would pray the two rakʿahs after the Maghrib [prayer] in his house.
items.ma-5863: [ʿAbd Allāh said:] Muṣʿab narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade najsh, like it.
items.ma-5909: And Muʾammal narrated it to us another time, and he did not say: from Ibn ʿUmar.
items.ma-6224: Nūḥ ibn Maymūn narrated to us, ʿAbd Allāh informed us, from Mūsā, from Sālim, from Ibn ʿUmar, that the Prophet ﷺ would pray witr on his mount.
items.ma-6261: Muʿtamir narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would set his mount crosswise and pray towards it.
items.ma-6282: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, ʿUbayd Allāh narrated to us, from Nāfiʿ, from Ibn ʿUmar, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that goods be met before they enter the markets.
items.ma-7256: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Saʿīd, from Abū Hurayrah, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “There is no faraʿah and no ʿatīrah.”
items.ma-7333: It was read to Sufyān: Abū al-Zinād, from al-Aʿraj, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ: “Indeed I see your humility.”
items.ma-7439: He said: And Wakīʿ said: from Abū Ṣāliḥ and Abū Razīn, from Abū Hurayrah, raising it: “Three times.”
items.ma-7487: “And in Friday there is an hour which no Muslim servant coincides with, standing, praying, asking Allah for something in it, except that He gives it to him.”
items.ma-7673: He said: And Ziyād also informed me that Hilāl ibn Usāmah informed him that he heard Abū Salamah informing of that, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ.
items.ma-7894: Marwān narrated to us, ʿAwf informed us, from al-Ḥasan, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-7895: Marwān narrated to us, ʿAwf informed us, from Ibn Sīrīn, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-7896: Yazīd ibn Hārūn narrated to us, Hishām informed us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said: “Indeed Allah ﷿ is Witr, Yuḥibbu al-Witr.”
items.ma-8137: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The Hour will not be established until about thirty dajjāls, liars, are sent forth, each of whom claims that he is the messenger of Allah.”
items.ma-8145: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When the call is made for the prayer, the Ṣubḥ prayer, and one of you is junub, let him not fast that day.”
items.ma-8148: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The purification of the vessel of one of you, when the dog has licked in it, is to wash it seven times.”
items.ma-8165: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When one of you performs istijmār, let him make [it] an odd number.”
items.ma-8178: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Allah ﷿ said: I am as My servant thinks of Me.”
items.ma-8186: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Do not urinate in standing water that does not flow, then perform ghusl from it.”
items.ma-8194: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “When one of you performs wuḍūʾ, let him draw water into his nostrils, then let him blow it out.”
items.ma-8200: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Spoils of war were not lawful for those before us. That is because Allah saw our weakness and our incapacity, so He made them good for us.”
items.ma-8222: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Allah does not accept the prayer of one of you if he has a ḥadath until he performs wuḍūʾ.”
items.ma-8245: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The eye is true,” and he forbade tattooing.
items.ma-8246: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “One of you remains in prayer as long as the prayer is what detains him, nothing preventing him except waiting for it.”
items.ma-8476: Qutaybah narrated to us, Layth narrated to us, from Yazīd ibn al-Hād, from ʿAmr ibn Quhayd al-Ghifārī, from Abū Hurayrah, and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-8571-2: He said: And I think he said: from the right of the ʿArsh a caller calls out in the seventh heaven: Give the one who spends a replacement, and give – or hasten – destruction to the one who withholds.
items.ma-8578: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj narrated to us, from ʿAṭāʾ, from ʿUthmān, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-8709: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed thinking well is part of the goodness of worshipping Allah.”
items.ma-8938: And he said: “The delay of a wealthy person is an injustice, and when one of you is referred to a solvent person, let him follow.”
items.ma-8962: And ʿAffān also narrated to us – meaning ʿAffān – from Khālid – I think he is al-Wāsiṭī – with its chain of narration and its meaning, except that he said: “And Allah accepts it with His Yamīn.”
items.ma-8992: ʿAffān narrated to us, Wuhayb narrated to us, Ayyūb narrated to us with this chain of narration, like it.
items.ma-9071: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, he said: al-Aʿmash informed us that he said: “Zakāh and mercy.”
items.ma-9133: Hawdhah narrated to us, he said: ʿAwf narrated to us, from Khilās, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said: “Upon every limb of the limbs of the son of Ādam is a ṣadaqah.”
items.ma-9189: Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, he said: Abū Isḥāq narrated to us, from al-Aʿmash, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, similar to this ḥadīth.
items.ma-9272: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Zayd narrated to us, he said: Thābit narrated to us, from Abū Rāfiʿ, from Abū Hurayrah: that the Prophet ﷺ prayed over a grave.
items.ma-9410: And he said: “And Allah ﷿ said: When My servant loves to meet Me, Aḥbabtu liqāʾahu, and when he dislikes to meet Me, Karihtu liqāʾahu.”
items.ma-9539: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr, from Abū Salamah, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said: “Every intoxicant is ḥarām.”
items.ma-9657: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Ibn ʿAjlān, he said: I heard my father, from Abū Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “My eye sleeps and my heart does not sleep.”
items.ma-9949: ʿAffān narrated to us, he said: Salīm narrated to us, he said: Saʿīd narrated to us, he said: I heard Abū Hurayrah saying: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Fasting is a shield.”
items.ma-10118: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad and Abū ʿĀmir narrated to us, both said: Hishām narrated to us, and they both mentioned it like it, except that they both said: “Whoever stands [in prayer during] Ramaḍān out of īmān.”
items.ma-10266-1: And: “When the servant of one of you prepares food and takes charge of its heat and its hardship, let him call him and let him eat with him; and if he does not call him, let him hand him some of it.”
items.ma-10301: I read to ʿAbd al-Raḥmān: Mālik, from Ibn Shihāb, from Ibn al-Musayyab, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like that.
items.ma-10371: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, he said: Hishām narrated to us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said: “Indeed Allah is Witr, Yuḥibbu al-Witr.”
items.ma-10390: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, he said: ʿAwf narrated to us, from Khilās, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like that.
items.ma-10395: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, he said: ʿAwf narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like that.
items.ma-10397: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, he said: ʿAwf narrated to us, from Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, with the like of that.
items.ma-10581: Yazīd narrated to us, Hishām informed us, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, who said: Whoever repented before the sun rises from its place of setting, Allah accepted his repentance.
items.ma-10604: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, and he mentioned it like it.
items.ma-10726: Maḥbūb ibn al-Ḥasan narrated to us, from Khālid, from Muḥammad, from Abū Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said: “Be named by my name, and do not be called by my kunyah.”
items.ma-11241: And indeed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “If the people knew what is for them in the adhān, they would strike one another over it with swords.”
items.ma-11382: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Thābit, from Abū Naḍrah, from Abū Saʿīd: that the Prophet ﷺ spat on his garment, then rubbed it.
items.ma-11431: Saʿīd ibn Manṣūr narrated to us, like it, with its chain of narration.
items.ma-11446: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Abū ʿĪsā al-Uswārī; and he mentioned it like it, except that he said: the sick person.
items.ma-11517: Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Sulaymān, from Dhakwān, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-11946: Hushaym narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ would go around to all his wives with one ghusl.
items.ma-12071: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade the gourd and the pitch-coated [vessel], and that [anything] be steeped in it.
items.ma-12078: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Zuhrī, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ held a walīmah for Ṣafiyyah with dates and sawīq.
items.ma-12091: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, that he heard the Prophet ﷺ pronouncing the talbiyah at al-Baydāʾ: “Labbayka for ʿumrah and Ḥajj together.”
items.ma-12095: It was read to Sufyān: I heard Ibn Judʿān, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said: “The voice of Abū Ṭalḥah in the army is better than a company.”
items.ma-12097: Sufyān narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to me, from Thābit, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ would go around to his wives in one night, performing one ghusl.
items.ma-12185: Wakīʿ narrated to us, al-Dastuwāʾī narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade that a man drink standing.
items.ma-12286: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from Jābir, from Abū Naṣr – or Khaythamah –, from Anas, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave me a kunyah after a herb that I used to pick.
items.ma-12419: Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī narrated to us, from Zāʾidah, from al-Mukhtār ibn Fulful, from Anas, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “I am the first intercessor in Paradise.”
items.ma-12437: al-Hāshimī – meaning Sulaymān – narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl, from Ḥumayd, from Anas, its meaning.
items.ma-12443: Abū al-Walīd narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said: “For every treacherous person there will be a banner on the Day of Resurrection by which he is known.”
items.ma-12455: Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān said: Abū Baḥr narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas, and he mentioned something like it.
items.ma-12490: Azhar ibn al-Qāsim al-Rāsibī narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that a man drink while he is standing.
items.ma-12664: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, he said: Maʿmar informed us, from Thābit, from Anas, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “None of you should wish for death.”
items.ma-12847: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Salamah ibn Wardān narrated to us, he said: I heard Anas ibn Mālik saying: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a khuṭbah upon the minbar.
items.ma-12849: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas ibn Mālik, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ only performed qunūt for a month, supplicating after the bowing.
items.ma-12857: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The son of the sister of a people is of them.”
items.ma-12862: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Hishām ibn Zayd, he said: I heard Anas say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the ṣabr of a beast.
items.ma-12871: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, Qatādah narrated to us, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade drinking while standing. I said: And eating? He said: That is worse.
items.ma-12898: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Laylā, from Thābit, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Labbayka for ʿumrah and Ḥajj together.”
items.ma-12911: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Anas ibn Sīrīn, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Prophet ﷺ performed qunūt for a month after the bowing.
items.ma-12956: Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh narrated to us, Ḥumayd narrated to us, from Anas: that he was asked: Did the Prophet ﷺ dye [his hair]? He said: Grey hair did not disfigure him.
items.ma-13099: Yazīd narrated to us, Saʿīd informed us, from Qatādah, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Prophet ﷺ freed Ṣafiyyah bint Ḥuyayy and made that her dower.
items.ma-13196: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that unripe dates and dates be steeped together.
items.ma-13450: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb narrated to us, from Saʿīd, from Qatādah, from Anas, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Spitting phlegm in the mosque is a sin, and its kaffārah is burying it.”
items.ma-13502: Ḥasan narrated to us, Zuhayr narrated to us, from Bayān, from Anas ibn Mālik, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ consummated his marriage with a woman, and he invited men to the food.
items.ma-13550: Surayj narrated to us, Abū ʿAwānah narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever forgets a prayer, let him pray it when he remembers it.”
items.ma-13556: ʿAlī ibn ʿĀṣim narrated to us, from Ḥumayd al-Ṭawīl, from Anas ibn Mālik, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed behind Abū Bakr in one garment, wrapped in it.
items.ma-13564: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas: that the Prophet ﷺ had hair that would reach his shoulders.
items.ma-13568: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from Anas: that the sandal of the Prophet ﷺ had two straps.
items.ma-13602: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, Anas ibn Sīrīn narrated to us, from Anas ibn Mālik: that the Prophet ﷺ performed qunūt for a month after the bowing.
items.ma-13944: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, Qatādah narrated to us, from Anas, who said: The Black Stone is from Paradise.
items.ma-14122: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, Zuhayr narrated to us, he said: I saw Ashʿath ibn Sawwār with Abū al-Zubayr, standing, and he was saying: How did he say it? And what did he say?
items.ma-14215: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sold the mudabbar.
items.ma-14216: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Ibn Abī Khālid and Sufyān narrated to us, from Salamah ibn Kuhayl, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Jābir: that the Prophet ﷺ sold the mudabbar.
items.ma-14290: Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir: that the Prophet ﷺ was asked about the earnings of the cupper, and he said: “Feed it to your water-carrying camel.”
items.ma-14305: Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Aswad, from Nubayḥ, from Jābir: that the Prophet ﷺ commanded that those killed at Uḥud be returned to the places where they fell.
items.ma-14319: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAmr, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Jābir: We used to take the meat of the sacrificial animals as provision, in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, to al-Madīnah.
items.ma-14489: Abū Nūḥ Qurād narrated to us, Mālik narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade that a man walk in one sandal.
items.ma-14605: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Jābir, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Be upright and receive glad tidings.”
items.ma-14687: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Jābir: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed, in his document, whoever does that.
items.ma-14691: Ḥasan narrated to us, Ibn Lahīʿah narrated to us, Abū al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Jābir, who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: “The bird of every servant is on his neck.”
items.ma-14843: Yūnus narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the gourd, the pitch-coated vessel and the naqīr.
items.ma-15143: Ḥasan narrated to us, Zuhayr narrated to us, from Abū al-Zubayr, from Jābir and Ibn ʿUmar: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the naqīr, the pitch-coated vessel and the gourd.
items.ma-15561: Bishr ibn al-Mufaḍḍal narrated to us, he said: Abū Ḥāzim narrated to us, from Sahl ibn Saʿd, who said: I saw the men take the midday rest and have their midday meal on the day of Friday.
items.ma-15884: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Yūnus, who said: I heard this ḥadīth from al-Mughīrah ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from his father; similar to it.
items.ma-16156: Hushaym narrated to us, from Yaʿlā ibn ʿAṭāʾ, from his father, from Aws ibn Aws al-Thaqafī, who said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ come to an underground water channel of a people and perform wuḍūʾ.
items.ma-16167: Wakīʿ narrated to us, he said: Shuʿbah narrated to us, from al-Nuʿmān ibn Sālim, from Ibn Abī Aws, from his grandfather, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed in his sandals.
items.ma-16246: Sulaymān narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, from Muʿāwiyah, who said: My father used to narrate to us from the Prophet ﷺ, and I do not know whether he heard it from him or was told it about him?
items.ma-16279: And I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: “A good fast is three days of the month.”
items.ma-17653: And Aḥmad ibn Janāb narrated to us, ʿĪsā ibn Yūnus narrated to us, and he mentioned something like it.
items.ma-18058: Qutaybah ibn Saʿīd narrated to us this ḥadīth, and he shortened part of the chain of narration, and he said: meaning by that the ṣadaqah, he takes it other than by its right.
items.ma-18465: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, from Sufyān, from Manṣūr, from Ibrāhīm, from ʿAlqamah, from ʿAbd Allāh, like the ḥadīth of Firās.
items.ma-18502: Bahz narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from ʿAdī ibn Thābit, from al-Barāʾ, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “For Ibrāhīm there is a wet-nurse in Paradise.”
items.ma-18645: Abū Dāwūd ʿUmar ibn Saʿd narrated to us, from Sufyān, like it, and he did not mention in it the spreading of salām, and he said: He forbade us the vessels of gold and silver.
items.ma-18656: Ibn Jaʿfar said: Shuʿbah said: And Abū al-Ḥasan informed me, from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib, like that.
items.ma-18659: ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿAmr narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Rabīʿ ibn al-Barāʾ, from his father al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib, like that.
items.ma-18735: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Sufyān narrated to us, from al-Suddī, from one who heard ʿAmr ibn Ḥurayth saying: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed in his sandals.
items.ma-18869: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from Abū Isḥāq, from ʿAlqamah ibn Wāʾil, from his father, who said: I heard the Prophet ﷺ saying āmīn aloud.
items.ma-18950: [ʿAbd Allāh ibn Aḥmad said:] Ḥawtharah ibn Ashras narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah narrated to us, and he mentioned something like it.
items.ma-19028: Ḥajjāj narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to me, from Qatādah, who said: I heard Zurārah ibn Awfā narrating from Ubayy ibn Mālik, from the Prophet ﷺ.
items.ma-19087: Yūnus narrated to us, from Ḥammād ibn Zayd, from al-Ṣunābiḥī, and perhaps he said: al-Ṣunābiḥ.
items.ma-19254: Ḥajjāj narrated it to us, Sharīk informed us, from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Mundhir ibn Jarīr, from his father, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said; and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-19583: Rawḥ narrated to us, ʿAwf narrated to us, from Qasāmah ibn Zuhayr, who said: I heard al-Ashʿarī. And he mentioned something like it.
items.ma-19746: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid al-Ḥaddād narrated to us, he said: Yūnus narrated to us, from Abū Burdah, from Abū Mūsā, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “There is no marriage except with a walī.”
items.ma-19762: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad narrated to us, he said: Hammām narrated to us, he said: Qatādah narrated to us, and he mentioned something like it. The beginning of
items.ma-19795: And I said to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: O Messenger of Allah, command me with a deed that I may do. So he said: “Remove harm from the road, for that is a ṣadaqah for you.”
items.ma-19847: ʿAbd al-Razzāq narrated to us, Maʿmar narrated to us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Hayyāj; and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-19854: al-Khaffāf narrated to us, Saʿīd informed us, from Abū Rajāʾ, from Ibn ʿAbbās, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-19923: Bahz narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn: that the Prophet ﷺ stoned.
items.ma-19958: ʿAffān narrated to us, Ḥammād narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from al-Ḥasan, from ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-20065: Hushaym narrated to us, from Yūnus, from al-Ḥasan, from Salamah ibn al-Muḥabbiq, from the Prophet ﷺ, and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-20132: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever kills his slave, we kill him; and whoever cuts off his nose, we cut off his nose.”
items.ma-20147: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, from Saʿīd, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The neighbour of the house has more right to the house.”
items.ma-20198: Yazīd ibn Hārūn narrated to us, from Abū Umayyah, a shaykh of his, who said: al-Ḥasan narrated to us, from Samurah, who said: “And whoever castrates his slave, we castrate him.”
items.ma-20249: Hushaym narrated to us, Yūnus informed us, from al-Ḥasan, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, and he mentioned like it,
items.ma-20254: ʿAffān narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The ʿumrā is permissible.”
items.ma-20258: Yūnus and Surayj narrated to us, both said: Ḥammād narrated to us, from Bishr, who said: I heard Samurah say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, like it.
items.ma-20261: ʿAffān narrated to us, Abān narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from Samurah, exactly like it.
items.ma-20267: ʿAffān narrated to us, Yazīd ibn Zurayʿ narrated to us, from Yūnus, who said: And when he finished the recitation of the sūrah.
items.ma-20517: Hāshim narrated to us, Mubārak narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, from Abū Bakrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “A people whom a woman rules will never succeed.”
items.ma-20712: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, Saʿīd narrated to us, Qatādah narrated to us, from Abū al-Malīḥ, from his father: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the skins of predators.
items.ma-20718: Abū Saʿīd narrated to us, from Hishām, from Qatādah, from Abū al-Malīḥ, like it, except that he did not mention “from his father.”
items.ma-20856: Aswad ibn ʿĀmir narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from Simāk, from Jābir ibn Samurah: that the Prophet ﷺ stoned a Jewish man and a Jewish woman.
items.ma-20969: Yaḥyā ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, Simāk narrated to me, from Jābir ibn Samurah, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said: “Indeed Allah named al-Madīnah Ṭābah.”
items.ma-20999: Abū al-Naḍr narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, Simāk narrated to us, from Jābir ibn Samurah, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had become streaked with grey; and he mentioned its meaning.
items.ma-22011: Abū Kāmil narrated to us, Ḥammād – meaning Ibn Salamah – narrated to us, from ʿAmr ibn Dīnār, from Ṭāwūs, from Muʿādh, and he mentioned something like it.
items.ma-22175: Ibrāhīm ibn Khālid narrated to us, Rabāḥ narrated to us, from Maʿmar, from Qatādah, from Shahr ibn Ḥawshab, from Abū Umāmah, like it.
items.ma-22205: Yaʿlā narrated to us, Ḥajjāj narrated to us, like it.
items.ma-22216: ʿIṣām ibn Khālid narrated to us, Ḥarīz narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Maysarah, who said: I heard Abū Umāmah, and he mentioned from the Prophet ﷺ something like it.
items.ma-22723: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, from Thābit, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-22761: ʿAlī ibn ʿAyyāsh narrated it to us, Ibn Thawbān narrated to us, and he mentioned something like it, except that he said: “From the envy of an envier and from every eye; the name of Allah heals you.”
items.ma-22954: Muʿtamir narrated to us, from Kahmas, from Ibn Buraydah, from his father, who said: He fought sixteen campaigns with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
items.ma-23242: Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Abū Wāʾil, from Ḥudhayfah: that when the Prophet ﷺ rose at night, he would scour his mouth with the siwāk.
