items.ma-23509: ʿAbd al-Jabbār ibn Muḥammad narrated to us, Baqiyyah narrated to us, from Baḥīr, and he mentioned something like it.
items.ma-23883: Muḥammad ibn Fuḍayl narrated to us, ʿĀṣim narrated to us, from Abū ʿUthmān, who said: Bilāl said: O Messenger of Allah, do not precede me with āmīn.
items.ma-23942: Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, Ḥaywah narrated to us, he said: Abū Hāniʾ informed me that Abū ʿAlī ʿAmr ibn Mālik al-Janbī, like it.
items.ma-24048: Muḥammad ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Khuṣayf; and Marwān narrated to us, he said: Khuṣayf narrated to us, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Umm Salamah, like that.
items.ma-24078: Sufyān narrated to us, he said: I heard it from al-Zuhrī, from ʿAmrah, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would cut [the hand] for a quarter of a dīnār and upwards.
items.ma-24112: Sufyān narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from al-Qāsim, from ʿĀʾishah: We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, not seeing anything but Ḥajj.
items.ma-24129: Sufyān narrated to us, from Maʿmar, from al-Zuhrī, from ʿUrwah, from ʿĀʾishah: The most beloved drink to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was the sweet, cold [one].
items.ma-24413: Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, Zāʾidah narrated to us, from Abū Ḥaṣīn, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from ʿĀʾishah, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed wearing a garment, part of which was on me.
items.ma-24887: Bahz narrated it to us – and he did not say “Muʿādhah narrated to me” – and he said: from, and from.
items.ma-25152: He said: And ʿĀʾishah said: When the righteous are mentioned, then ḥayyahalā with ʿUmar.
items.ma-25206: Yaḥyā ibn Ādam narrated to us, Sharīk narrated to us, from al-Suddī, from ʿAmr ibn Maymūn, from ʿĀʾishah: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would have skin contact while he was fasting.
items.ma-25222: Hāshim narrated to us, Isrāʾīl narrated to us, from Jābir, from ʿĀmir, from Masrūq, from ʿĀʾishah, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would pray while I was opposite him.
items.ma-25292: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Zakariyyā, from al-ʿAbbās ibn Dharīḥ, from al-Shaʿbī, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ashʿath ibn Qays, from ʿĀʾishah, like it.
items.ma-25349: Ibrāhīm ibn Khālid narrated to us, Rabāḥ narrated to us, from Maʿmar, from Qatādah, who said: Muʿādhah al-ʿAdawiyyah narrated to me, and he mentioned it.
items.ma-25555: And he said, from ʿĀʾishah: The comprehensive [forms] of supplication would please the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he would leave what is between that.
items.ma-25582: Yaḥyā narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, from Manṣūr. He said: Sheep.
items.ma-25679: Ḥajjāj narrated to us exactly like the ḥadīth of Ibn Jaʿfar. He said: “The biting dog.” And Ibn Jaʿfar said: The biting.
items.ma-25695: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Shuʿbah, from Abū Isḥāq, from ʿĀṣim, from ʿAlī. And Sufyān, from Abū Ḥaṣīn; and he mentioned them both together.
items.ma-25729: Wakīʿ narrated to us, Hishām narrated to us, from his father, from ʿĀʾishah, who said: The bedding of the Prophet ﷺ was of tanned leather stuffed with fibre.
items.ma-25817: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, Ayyūb narrated to us, he said: I heard al-Qāsim saying: ʿĀʾishah said: I perfumed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for his ḥill and for his ḥurm.
items.ma-26047: Ibn Abī ʿAdī narrated to us, from Dāwūd, from ʿĀmir, from ʿĀʾishah, that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The Dajjāl will not enter Makkah or al-Madīnah.”
items.ma-26284: Ibn Abī ʿAdī narrated to us, from Saʿīd, from a man, from Abū Maʿshar, from Ibrāhīm, from ʿĀʾishah, similar to it.
items.ma-26301: Ḥusayn narrated to us, he said: Shaybān narrated to us, from Manṣūr, and he mentioned it with its chain of narration and its meaning.
items.ma-26447: Abū Muʿāwiyah narrated to us, al-Aʿmash narrated to us, from Muslim, from Shutayr ibn Shakal, from Ḥafṣah, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would kiss while he was fasting.
items.ma-26607: Abū ʿUbaydah al-Ḥaddād narrated to us, Hammām narrated to us, from Qatādah, from al-Ḥasan, from Ḍabbah ibn Miḥṣan, from Umm Salamah, from the Prophet ﷺ, like it.
items.ma-26820: Ḥajjāj and Abū Kāmil narrated to us, both said: Layth narrated to us, he said: Ibn Shihāb narrated to me, from Ḥabīb, the mawlā of ʿUrwah, from Nudbah, and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
items.ma-27155: Wakīʿ narrated to us, from Yūnus – meaning Ibn Abī Isḥāq – who said: I heard this ḥadīth from al-Mughīrah ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from his father, similar to it.
items.ma-27321: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, he said: Sufyān narrated to us, from Manṣūr, from Mujāhid, from Tamīm, the mawlā of Fāṭimah, from Fāṭimah bint Qays, similar to it.
items.ma-27389: Sufyān narrated to us, from Ibn Abī Najīḥ, from Mujāhid, from Umm Hāniʾ, who said: The Prophet ﷺ once came to Makkah, and he had four braids.
items.ma-27539: ʿAffān narrated to us, Shuʿbah narrated to us, he said: Mughīrah informed me, he said: I heard Ibrāhīm say: ʿAlqamah went to al-Shām, and he mentioned the ḥadīth.
